articleTitle: Combined Longitudinal and Lateral Control of Vehicle Platoons
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: With the development of intelligent and electrified vehicle, more and more researches on automated drive are put forward in recent years. This paper presents the controller which combines the trajectory tracking control and adaptive cruise control for realizing lateral and longitudinal control for a mini-vehicle platoon. A decoupled controller for lateral and longitudinal control is designed to keep the platoon stable. A lateral control system for trajectory tracking is proposed, which consists of a desired heading error generator based on vehicle-road kinematic relation and a feedback control system using robust PID controller based on vehicle-road dynamics model. A longitudinal control system designed for adaptive cruise control is established to achieve desired inter-vehicular distance. To validate the effect of the control system, simulations in two scenarios are conducted, and the experiment based on the mini-vehicle platform is designed. The simulation and experiment results show that vehicle platooning could achieve string stability while driving along trajectory at a low velocity.

articleTitle: An Effective Network Attack Detection Method Based on Kernel PCA and LSTM-RNN
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Intrusion Detection System (IDS) is built to detect both known and unknown malicious attacks. Several machine learning algorithms are used widely in IDS such as neural network, SVM, KNN etc. However, these algorithms have still some limitations such as high false positive and false alarm rate. To overcome above challenge, we propose a novel effective attack detection method based on kernel principal component analysis (PCA) and long short-term memory recurrent neural network (LSTM-RNN). To achieve high accurate detection rate, data preprocessing, feature extraction, attack detection is seamlessly integrated into an end-to-end detection method. To assess the method, the well-known NSL-KDD dataset has been used. The results of experimental show that the proposed attack detection strategy greatly outperforms several attack detection strategy that use SVM, neural network or Bayesian methods.

articleTitle: Prediction of Air Quality Index Based on Improved Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In order to realize the prediction of city air quality status, this paper uses the improved BP neural network to establish a prediction model of air quality index. The model uses the characteristics of nonlinear fitting approximation of BP neural network to solve the problem that air quality has many influencing factors and is nonlinear and difficult to predict. Aiming at the problem of slow convergence and easy to fall into local optimal solution of BP neural network, genetic algorithm is used to optimize. This paper takes Xuchang city as an example. Results show that the average relative error of the air quality index is 22%. The accuracy rate was 80.44%. The accuracy level of air quality is 82.5%. Compared with the BP neural network, BP neural network prediction improved has a higher accuracy. The model has certain feasibility and adaptability.

articleTitle: The Unmanned Autonomous Cruise Ship for Water Quality Monitoring and Sampling
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Regular manual sampling and fixed node on-line detection are main methods of water quality monitoring in waters at present. Sampling nodes are subj ect to great restrictions. This paper presents an autonomous cruise unmanned ship for water quality monitoring and sampling, which can be achieved in the waters of any designated location for water quality sampling, achieves the real-time on-line monitoring of the whole water environment by means of the combination of dynamic nodes and static monitoring nodes. This paper introduces the control unit system, the ground station control unit system and the water quality sampling and the monitoring unit system of the unmanned ship and carries out the actual test. The unmanned ship designed in this paper has successfully achieved autonomous cruise, designated water quality sampling and dynamic online real-time water quality monitoring, which provides a new means for water quality monitoring in waters.

articleTitle: Quadrotor UAVs Flying Formation Reconfiguration with Collision Avoidance Using Probabilistic Roadmap Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This paper proposes an idea about the quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) flying formation reconfiguration with collision avoidance and computation of the probabilistic roadmap (PRM) navigation method for nonlinear quadcopter model in dynamic environment. The safe zone and dangerous zone strategy have been adopted to reach the target position. A novel algorithm using probabilistic roadmap is proposed for collision avoidance. Two dimensional PD controllers are proposed for better path tracking and stability. The complete model of this system is simulated in MATLAB/Simulink. The response of path tracking, collision avoidance and flying formation of each UAV are discussed in detail. Results highlight the collision avoidance depends upon a total number of nodes and distance between two consecutive nodes according to the roadmap.

articleTitle: Analysis of Eddy Current Effect and Loss Calculation of Transformer Winding Based on Finite Element Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The leakage magnetic field of the transformer is related to the design, manufacture and operating performance of the transformer. The size and distribution of the leakage magnetic field determines the short circuit reactance of the transformer, the eddy current loss of the winding, the eddy current loss in the metal structure, and the electromagnetic force on the winding under normal and faulty operating conditions, and to a large extent determine temperature rise of the winding and transformer Other parts. Eddy current loss caused by Transformer winding leakage magnetic field accounted for a larger proportion of additional losses and will produce local transformer overheating, life shortened. The error of traditional empirical formula calculation method about the transformer winding eddy current loss is large, in order to accurately calculate the transformer winding eddy current loss. Based on the ANSYS finite element analysis method, we establish the finite element model of the dry-type transformer, analyze the distribution of the magnetic flux leakage of the transformer and obtain the eddy current loss distribution and loss value of the transformer. The comparison between the theoretical calculation and the simulation results of the eddy current loss shows that the calculation method of the finite element analysis method is more accurate.

articleTitle: Novel Real-time Face Recognition from Video Streams
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Real-time recognition from video streams is a very challenging task due to background, facial expressions, and lighting differences. Recent studies show that deep learning approaches can achieve impressive performance on this task. Our system solves these problems well using deep learning method. It contains face detection module and face recognition module. Our face detection module is based on MTCNN, which is very fast and accurate, and is robust enough for changes in lighting differences and background. Our face recognition module is based on FaceNet, which directly learns mapping the face images to the points in Euclidean space, where the distance of two points in Euclidean space directly corresponds to how similar two face images are. Once such Euclidean space is created, we transform the face images into the FaceNet embedding, as the feature vectors for face images. Next, we put the feature vectors into an SVM classifier to help us quickly identify the face images. The experimental results show that the system has very high accuracy and low computational complexity, which is the key to real-time face recognition, and has significant value in application.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Transformer Core Vibration and Noise Under DC Bias Condition
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In a high-voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission system operating in monopolar ground circuit mode, the earth electrode current flows into the transformer windings through the neutral point of the transformer. This situation leads to the DC bias phenomenon, which has many adverse effects on the transformer body, including insulation damage as well as increases in transformer loss, temperature, vibration, and noise [1]. Applying the basic theory of electromagnetic fields, this paper analyzes the effective coupling of several fields (electric, magnetic, structural force, and acoustic) by applying COMSOL Multiphysics software; we also obtain the vibration and noise distribution of the transformer before and after DC bias [2] [3].

articleTitle: An Improved Pedestrian Navigation System Using IMU and Magnetometer
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The pedestrian navigation system (PNS)based on pedestrian dead reckoning (PDR) is a kind of navigation and positioning system which relies on pedestrians themselves. It can determine the pedestrian's current position real-timely. In this paper, we consider pedestrian navigation system in devices equipped with the foot-mounted IMU, where we designa pedestrian dead reckoning algorithm based on step size estimation. The peak detection algorithm is used for the gait recognition and step frequency detection. PDR contains gait detection algorithm, step size estimation algorithm and the heading angle provided by magnetometer and Inertial navigation system (INS). In order to reduce the error, we consider the Kalman filter fusion to achieve the heading information. Since pedestrian movement is often a combination of walking and running gait, we propose a navigation scheme of walking / running combination, and prove the feasibility of the scheme by walking / running combination experiment.

articleTitle: Improved SNR Estimation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: As for several NDA SNR estimation algorithm for QPSK signal, their SNR estimation performance is poor. This article puts forward an improved low complexity SNR estimation algorithm to improve the SNR estimation range and accuracy. The mean, bias and variance of the new algorithm are simulated. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has smaller estimation bias and estimated mean square error in the SNR range between -10~30dB, and its estimation performance is obviously superior to other already existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Prediction of Vehicle Motion Based on Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The prediction of vehicle motion plays a key role in many ways. Such as the road congestion identification, the references for the drivers, the construction of the city road network, and the design of the vehicular network routing. We propose a vehicle motion model considering the real vehicle movement scene in this paper. First, we analyze the motion of the vehicle with the data from May 1 to June 10 in shanghai. By sampling the data, we compute the cumulative distribution function of the entropy of the vehicle. Then, according to the characteristics of the entropy of each order, we select the second order Markov to establish the corresponding motion model. Finally we introduce the holidays and the flow of traffic in different periods in a day to the model. The performance of the vehicle motion prediction model we propose is more accuracy than that of the traditional second-order Markov.

articleTitle: Space Laser Chaotic Security System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This paper mainly discusses the application of variable parameter chaotic hybrid keying system in space laser communication without reducing the anti-jamming capability and signal transmission rate of existing space laser communication system, and analyzes its anti-jamming capability.

articleTitle: Study on Peak Shaving Strategy of Pumped Storage Power Station Combined with Wind and Photovoltaic Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: With the increase of wind and photovoltaic power generation grid scale, the anti-surge characteristics of wind power and output volatility of photovoltaic generation put forward new challenges to the safety of power grid. Moreover, the height consistency of photovoltaic output peak and load daytime trough aggravated the load pressure of power system. In this paper, the output characteristics of pumped storage units is studied to optimize the output power and boot mode of the pumped storage power station, so as to promote the consumption of wind and photovoltaic power and to participate in the power system peak shaving. In this paper, the mathematical model of peak shaving strategy of pumped storage power station combined with wind-photovoltaic power generation is written and emulate based on the Localsolver optimization tool, and the results verify the effectiveness of this optimization strategy. When the installed capacity of the pumping station is close to that of wind and photovoltaic power generation, the load curve can be well followed by adjusting the output power of pumped storage units in the premise of the complete consumption of wind and photovoltaic power generation.

articleTitle: Research on Location Assignment Model of Intelligent Warehouse with RFID and Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Reasonable warehouse storage planning and assignment is the key to reduce the product storage and retrieve time and improve warehouse operation efficiency. Moreover, capturing and sharing the information of warehouse in real time is the premise of warehouse location assignment, and internet of things has provided this information required by leveraging the growing ubiquity of radiofrequency identification (RFID). Firstly this paper describes the layout of intelligent warehouse, then a multi-objective intelligent warehouse location assignment model is proposed with many constrain rules. Finally we develop an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm to solve the model, and verify the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Fault Prediction of Rolling Bearing Based on ARMA Model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This paper researches the fault prediction of rolling bearing according to ARMA model. A fault prediction method is firstly presented based on ARMA model. Then, the fault prediction of rolling bearing is also experimentally studied by the rolling bearing overheat fault test. Through overheat fault tests under two different temperatures, the fault prediction results verify the prediction effectiveness of proposed method.

articleTitle: Multi-Algorithm Collaboration Scheduling Strategy for Docker Container
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: As the most popular container technology, Docker can provide more efficient solution for virtualization. Swarm is a management tool for Docker cluster. Since it is simple and flexible, Swarm is suitable for building private cloud platform. However, the strategies Swarm currently supports cannot achieve good performance of load balancing in some cases. To solve this problem, we present a new scheduling strategy named Multi-Algorithm Collaboration Scheduling Strategy, which can satisfy various scheduling requirements by using different algorithm specifically designed for different cases to process requests in turns. The results of comparison experiment suggest that the presented strategy has a more comprehensive performance than other strategies for Swarm.

articleTitle: Forecast on Bus Trip Demand Based on ARIMA Models and Gated Recurrent Unit Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Bus is the most basic trip mode in public transport system. Precise bus trip generation forecast indicates the short-term number of passengers in each bus station, providing passengers information to optimize trip strategy. The ARIMA models and gated recurrent unit neural networks were developed to predict bus trip demand in different intervals including the 30-minute, 1-hour, 2-hour and 4-hour intervals based on the I C card data in Shenzhen, China. Time series data was structured by the IC card record, where one record was viewed as a passenger in this station. The comparison results suggested that the GRU NN models provide better prediction accuracy than the ARIMA model for different time intervals. The developed GRU NNs can be further used to guide the bus network optimization and urban planning.

articleTitle: The Modeling Analysis of Wireless Power Transmission Under the Basic Topology Structure
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: As it seeks to explore the magnetic coupling resonance wireless power transmission system, the mutual inductance coupling theory of space four air-core coil and equivalent circuit were used to analyze output power and transmission efficiency of wireless power system. Then, equivalent circuit of transmitter series and receiver series compensation structure was achieved. Accordingly, output power and transmission efficiency of this structure were further obtained and they were stimulated using MATLAB simulation software. Thus, the relationship among resonance angular frequency and output power or transmission efficiency was revealed. Three other compensation circuit structures were discussed separately and their expressions of output power and transmission efficiency were obtained. Finally, the simulation is respectively carried out under the condition that all parameters are the same and their performance is compared and analyzed. The analysis of different compensation circuits can provide useful reference for the design of wireless charging system structure.

articleTitle: Research on Determination Method of Electronic Equipment Incoming Defect in Batch Production
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: To solve the determination problem of electronic equipment incoming defect in batch production, a method for determining the number of introduced defects in different batches of products is given in this paper based on the summary of the current method of calculating the number of defects. When the batch number of product is not small, the determination method of incoming defect based on failure data of environmental stress screening test and the determination method of incoming defect under no failure condition are given; when the product is first delivered, the determination method of incoming defect is given based on the defect discovered in field and defect discovered in factory, and the test data collection table of parts in factory is given. The method in this paper can deal with the incoming defect determination without handbook data of part fraction defective.

articleTitle: Face Detection System Based on Video Stream
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: With the development of electronic information and computer science technology, video capture becomes simpler and storage costs are rapidly declining, resulting in a dramatic increase in the amount of available video. In such circumstances, purely manual annotation and processing has been unable to deal with the massive video data. This has led to a growing demand for automated video analytics and interpretation technologies. The key underlying rationale for these video analytics applications is the automatic detection algorithm for video targets. In this paper, we analyze the common face detection algorithm and video streaming face detection applications. Combined with the actual situation, we design and implement a face detection system based on video streaming.

articleTitle: Monitor Pupils' Attention by Image Super-Resolution and Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Academic success at young age substantially lays on in-class behavior. Looking at the right spatial element - teacher or board for instance - can be considered as the first and main step towards mental focus. In this paper, we propose a novel method for monitoring pupils' attention from classic surveillance videos, based on focus points determination and classification. This approach raises two main challenges: the low-resolution of children's faces and the categorization of the focus points itself. Indeed, the gaze point of each student is deduced from his facial landmarks, which allow us to know his head pose (by solving the PnP problem). But the resolutions of the students' faces are usually 40x40 or even smaller. Therefore, we propose to combine the super-resolution algorithm to more accurately estimate the facial landmarks of the pupils in the last few rows. To achieve the second hard task - classification - and detect the children who do not pay attention to the proper spatial area, we consider the distribution of the focus points in two dimensions. After what we discriminate the anomalous points on a density criterion. Experiments on several real videos demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of this process.

articleTitle: A Segmented Network Method Based Faulted Line Selection Strategy for Single-Phase Earth Fault in Small Current Grounding Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: At present, the reliability of faulted line selection of single-phase earth fault in distribution network is generally low. This paper proposes a segmented network method based faulted line selection strategy. And the strategy is verified through an emtp simulation by modeling a 10kV ungrounded distribution network. The simulation results prove that the proposed strategy can realize reliable selection of faulted line with single-phase earth fault in distribution network through a small number of switching operations, and it is helpful to deal with single-phase earth fault in distribution network automatically.

articleTitle: Advanced Naïve Bayes Algorithm Design with Part-of-Speech Tagger on Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Applying Naïve Bayes classifier to do sentiment analysis is costly and wastes a lot of computation resources, since it takes all words from corpus into consideration and calculates each word's frequency. However, this is unnecessary. We select certain types of words to train our model and hope to find the sentiment of a document concentrates on which types of words. We use POS-tagging to select certain types of words and train our model. Our experiment shows that the sentiment of a document concentrates on adjectives and verbs. Thus, we can only take adjectives and verbs as training set. This helps to reduce the computation complexity.

articleTitle: Research on Algorithm of Program Code Similarity Detection
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Code plagiarism is a kind of cheating that often occurs in programming courses, detecting the source code of plagiarism, and verifying the originality of student program assignments are important in teaching. The similarity detection of program code is the key technology of plagiarism detection. This paper gives the definition of code similarity, introduces the code anti-plagiarism technology and several common code similarity detection methods.

articleTitle: Design of Wireless Sensor Network for Cold Storage Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, a monitoring system of cold storage ring is designed based on the characteristics of Zigbee wireless sensor network (WSN) and the actual situation of cold storage, which Including ZigBee network hardware and software design. The ZigBee WSN routing protocol Cluster Tree is improved, neighbor table information is drew into in the Cluster Tree algorithm, also studied the selection of nodes in neighbor table, It is beneficial to find an optimal path and reduce the delay of data transmission. The Zigbee WSN is used in the cold storage monitoring system, so it can be used for a long time with only one installation, which can solve the problems of complicated equipment and low efficiency in the traditional cold storage management. The test results show that the system meets the design requirements, so as to achieve the purpose of real-time monitoring of cold storage items.

articleTitle: Kinematics Modeling and Simulation of a 4-DOF Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This manipulator is used for partial discharge (PD) detection of the High Voltage Switch Cabinet in substations. In order to realize the motion control of the manipulator, the kinematic model is bulit by Denavit-Hanenberg (DH) method. Based on this model, the forward kinematics and inverse kinematics solutions of the manipulator are obtained by geometric method. Then, we use the Matlab Robotic Toolbox to simulate the robotic arm and verify the correctness of the forward and inverse kinematics solutions. Finally, the manipulator simulation and control software is developed based on OpenGL and VS software, and this system obtains good results in the practice of substation operation.

articleTitle: Methods for Underwater Sonar Image Processing in Objection Detection
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: It is important to improve the integrity and accuracy of sonar image target detection, which is significant for underwater detection. In this paper, a variety of sonar image denoising algorithms and segmentation algorithms are studied, and a denoising algorithm based on fast curve transform is proposed. The image segmentation algorithm based on k-means clustering is studied, and the optimal clustering number screening and sonar image subsurface segmentation are realized. The sonar image fast segmentation algorithm based on ICM algorithm and the object contour detection of sonar image based on level set method are realized in Matlab. The results show that the proposed algorithm can improve the noise reduction effect of the sonar image under reverberation interference, and obtain a better image detection effect.

articleTitle: Application of Chaos in Image Processing and Recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The probability of generating chaos can be substantially increased by cross-iteration between a class of special quadratic functions and random ones, and the result in [1]-[3] shows that it is a better method to construct chaotic system. This paper works on the chaotic characteristic of the dynamic system that constitutes of a quadratic surface mapping and an image function in a spatial unit area, the chaotic attractor is discovered as a new characteristic for image recognition. The chaotic characteristic is analyzed by calculating the Lyapunov exponent and drawing the bifurcation diagram. It is found that the chaotic characteristic of discrete surface and image is similar to the continuum. The chaotic attractor changes with the parameters and surface control points, and so with the sequence images. In particular, the number of the attractor points but the distributive distinction can be changed by slightly adjusting the surface or image, and it has important significance for research on pattern recognition or vision mechanism. In addition, the experimental result shows that using the image chaotic attractor to recognize different human faces is measurable, of course, there are many problems should be researched necessarily.

articleTitle: A LED Driver with Line-Voltage-Compensation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This paper presents a line-voltage-compensation technique for the light emitting diode (LED) driver. The line voltage is detected from the pin of the LED-driver chip by the phase detection method, and then a dc voltage resulted from the detected line voltage is used to modulate the current flowing through the LEDs by certain mathematical operation. With the proposed technique, the power of the LED lighting system is maintained constantly without additional peripheral devices. Compared to the conventional line-voltage-compensation technique, the proposed technique shows the virtue of simplicity and small area. The LED drip with the proposed line-voltage-compensation is designed and simulated with O.6μm BCD process. The simulation results show that the linear-adjustment rate is lower than 1%.

articleTitle: Stress and Sinking Property Analysis of Legged Robot Foot with Toe Structure in Soft Soil
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Sinking problem limits the walking performer of legged robot working in soft soil. The shape of robot's foot is very important to its sinking property. In order to study the influence of foot geometric shape on its sinking property in soil, Multi-Material Arbitrary Langrange-Euler (MM-ALE) method are used in the numerical simulation of sinking process of robot foot with different shape in soil. The results of soil's flow trend and stress distribution, and foot sinkage are analyzed, which show that multi-toe structure influences the direction of soil's flow and the direction of principal stress, and helps to form a low velocity area at the corner of multi-toe foot, and leads to the decreasing of the sinkage of robot foot. The rib and groove structures are added to the cross-shaped of foot, and the results show that the groove changes the principal stress direction of soil under robot foot, which influences soil's flowing tread, and make soil compact locally, so sinkage is decreased. This research provides a valuable reference for the shape design of legged robot foot walking in soil.

Author Keywords: Shape feature of legged robot foot

articleTitle: SEInjector: A Dynamic Fault Injection Tool for Soft Errors on X86
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Soft errors, mainly caused by Single event upsets in space, is one of the most serious problems for space applications running in hash environments. For accurately assessing the reliability of these applications toward soft errors, researchers always apply fault injection techniques to simulate the effects aroused by SEU. This paper presents a new fault injection tool, SEInjector. Based on the dynamic instrument framework PIN, SEInjector can inject faults into applications for x86 at runtime, without revision or recompilation. This tool provides the following advantages: 1. It can confine the fault injection within a specified code segment, which provides a method to analysis the effectiveness of fault tolerance techniques towards that code segment. 2. It deletes the unused register file from the target, thus prunes the fault injection space. 3. The fault injection processes can be executed with multi-thread.

articleTitle: A Feature Extraction Method of Network Traffic for Time-Frequency Synchronization Applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Network traffic embodies network behaviors and users' activity patterns, which holds many inherent features and dynamic properties. Feature extraction for network traffic in the network plays an significantly important role in time-frequency synchronization applications. How to accurately extract the hidden properties and features of network traffic has an important impact on network activities, such as network failure positioning, anomaly detection, and performance analysis. To this end, this paper propose a new feature extraction method to characterize network traffic. Firstly, the time-frequency analysis theory is used to transform network traffic in time-frequency synchronization applications to the time-frequency domain. Then the cluster analysis theory is used to dig and extract network traffic feature components. And the k-means analysis method is exploited to refine the hidden features of network traffic in the time domain. Finally, to validate our feature analysis method, we conduct an anomaly detection test. Simulation results show that our approach is promising.

articleTitle: Research on Semantic Annotation Based Image Fusion Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: There exists semantic gap between the user demand and the image fusion process. In order to solve the problem, a semantic labeling model of images is proposed and an image fusion mechanism based on semantic annotation is presented. The fusion mechanism is based on the semantic similarity of concepts. Experimental results show that the image fusion mechanism can improve the efficiency of image fusion.

articleTitle: Analysis and Simulation of Interaction Mechanism Between Agricultural Tracked Vehicle and Ground
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The interaction mechanism between the triangular track mechanism and the ground was simulated under static condition and uniform linear motion condition in ABAQUS based on Bakker theory in this research. The relationship between the stress change and the deformation of the track plate under two basic working conditions was clarified. The relationship between the soil settlement under the track plate and the ground pressure was discussed systematically. On this basis, the change regulation of interaction mechanism between the triangular track mechanism and the ground was made clear. Therefore, interaction analysis model of triangle crawler mechanism and elastic-plastic ground under various working situations was established. On the basis of preliminary studies, the important basic data can be provided for the optimal design of triangle tracked mechanism mounted on all types of agricultural machinery.

articleTitle: Blind Recognition of Binary Linear Block Code
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Rank criteria, a conventional recognition method of error correcting codes, was widely used for noiseless channel before. In this paper, the recognition of binary linear block code is considered, and it is different from the previous works. Firstly, an improved algorithm based on rank calculating to recognize code length is proposed. Then, an algorithm based on probability statistics to recognize synchronization deviation is used. At last, the parity check matrix is recovered by performing an elementary row transformation of the dual vectors. The analysis is confirmed by experimental results.

articleTitle: Efficient Incremental Pagerank of Evolving Graphs on GPU
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Real-world graphs such as social graphs are evolving over time. When a graph changes, its historical result becomes invalid and needs re-computing. However, performing re-computing on the new complete graph costs lots of power, resource, and cannot meet the real-time requirement of applications. In this paper, we study the problem of incremental Pagerank computation over dynamic graphs on GPU. We propose a UGAS computation model and a I-Pagerank system for incremental Pagerank computations on hybrid CPU and GPU platforms. Experiment results manifest good performance of our approaches.

articleTitle: Improvement on Live Migration of Virtual Machine by Limiting the Activity of CPU
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In the process of virtual machine live migration, the use of pre-copy technique can effectively reduce the downtime. However, when the generation rate of dirty pages is higher than the transmission rate, the dirty pages will accumulate, resulting in the failure of live migration. To avoid the live migration get failed, this paper proposes a method that can ensure the success of live migration by reducing the activity of CPU and adding a mandatory stop condition. The experimental results show that the total time of live migration and the transmission data size are decreased by the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Fourier Series-Based Anomaly Extraction Approach to Access Network Traffic in Power Telecommunications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This paper studies anomaly detection approaches about access network traffic in power telecommunications. Firstly, we use the Fourier series expansion theory to analyze the features in access network traffic for power telecommunications. Access network traffic is regarded as a discrete time series. Then we perform the Fourier series expansion process for access network traffic. Secondly, according to the Fourier series expansion of access network traffic, we construct the Fourier series expansion matrix. Thirdly, we the principal component analysis theory to decompose the matrix. The hidden properties about access network traffic are dug out. Then we propose a detection algorithm to find out the abnormal part in access network traffic in power telecommunications. Simulation results show that our approach is effective.

articleTitle: An Asynchronous Mi-Based BCI for Brain-Actuated Robot Grasping Control
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The brain-actuated robot grasping control is a hard and complex problem due to the low classification accuracy of mental pattern and the high degree of freedom of robot hand and arm. We propose an asynchronous MI-based BCI that allows the user to control the moving direction of robot hand and arm by intension whenever he feels necessary to adjust the moving path. In order to improve the classification accuracy and real-time performance, the thresholding method and LDS modeling approach are employed for online motor imagery pattern recognition. Then, the shared control strategy combines the automatic grasping control of robot and mental control by our asynchronous MI-based BCI to grasp the object with obstacle. Finally, the two experiments illustrate the advantages of our methods in the classification accuracy and grasping performance aspects.

articleTitle: The Decoupling Algorithm of Phased Array Radar Seeker Based on the Stability of Beam
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Phased array radar seeker technology is an important development realm of today's military power in the world. For the way of whole strapdown, the coupling between missile attitude and beam direction is one of the key technologies needing to be solved at present. This paper proposed a decoupling algorithm based on stability of the beam for the coupling problem which caused by the interference of missile attitude, extracted the line of sight rate in pitching and yaw directions. The theory process of beam stability algorithm was deduced in detail, and the decoupling matrix was solved by the algorithm. According to the results of simulation experiments, it showed that the algorithm is a good way to isolate the missile attitude disturbance in beam direction, and proved that the algorithm based on stability of the beam is effective in decoupling and extracting the line of sight of phased array radar seeker.

articleTitle: Application of the Main Steam Temperature Control Based on Sliding Multi-Level Multi-Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of electric power industry technology in recent years, the main steam temperature control method for large capacity thermal power units, based on the multi-model predictive control method, has become a research hotspot. The main difficulties of the multi-mode predictive control method in the main steam temperature control application are focus on the model switching method, the resisting disturbance abilities and the impact on the control performance of the model predictive control system while the load changed lightly. The main focus of this paper is to redesign the predictive control structure of the main steam temperature system by using multi-level and multi-model structure. This article has divided the model switching area into the lagging area and the sliding switching area. The sliding switch weight values of each prediction model has also been considered and drawn into the control method. A simulation in the ideal environment with using the operation data of the real 60 MW thermal generation model has been done. By analysing the simulation results, the main steam temperature control curves have been smoother and more stable.

articleTitle: Dead-time Compensation Strategy Based on SVPWM
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The dead-time effect of the three-phase bridge inverter is analyzed in this paper, which the dead-time compensation strategy of the inverter is proposed based on SVPWM. The theoretical analysis and the experimental results indicate that the effect caused by the current distortion is improved when dead-time is compensated, with strong practicality and little calculation.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Intelligent Diagnosis Based on Subtractive Clustering Adaptive Neural Fuzzy Inference System and Information Gain
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This paper uses a new intelligent method for the diagnosis of fatal breast cancer. The method combines the information gain method and the subtractive clustering adaptive neural fuzzy inference system (IG-SCANFIS). Information Gain method was applied to reduce the attributes dimension and then applies the selected attributes as input to SCANFIS. The SCANFIS model uses the subtractive clustering algorithm to cluster the input data to obtain the fuzzy rules and establish the neural fuzzy reasoning system. The system is used to diagnosis the breast cancer. The data sets used for training and testing were obtained from the University of California, Irvine (UCI) machine learning library. The simulation result shows that the proposed method has high prediction accuracy and the accuracy rate is as high as 99.44%.

articleTitle: Study on Edge Detection Method of Aluminum Foil Image
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The machine vision method is used to detect the surface defects of aluminum foil image, as the problem of location deviation is inevitable in image sequence imaging, and an image edge detection algorithm is used to extract aluminum foil image sequences efficiently. Firstly, the SUSAN operator is used to detect the edge of the foil image, and threshold aluminum foil images are obtained to determine the effective region of the foil in the image. Then, the nearest neighbor pixel filling method is used to carry out the nonlinear correction of the extracted aluminum foil image boundary. The experimental results show that the proposed method can extract the aluminum foil region quickly and accurately, and it lays a good foundation for the detection and recognition of aluminum foil surface defects.

articleTitle: Collaborative Filtering Recommendation Algorithm Based on Hybrid Similarity
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: As the traditional collaborative filtering algorithm only relies on user ratings to calculate the similarity between users, and then find each user's K neighbors, finally recommend according to the K neighbor set. However, in the face of large data processing, the traditional collaborative filtering algorithm is sparsely populated, resulting in the recommendation is not obvious. A collaborative filtering algorithm for hybrid similarity is proposed for this problem. The algorithm is mainly focused on the fusion of the user rating similarity and social similarity, so as to make recommendation more suitable for the user and improve the recommended quality of the algorithm. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper has lower MAE value than the traditional cooperative filtering algorithm and improves the recommended quality.

articleTitle: A Fast Efficient Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm for Coverage of Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, the standard particle swarm algorithm is applied to the coverage problem of wireless sensor networks, and the influence of particle flight velocity on the convergence of WSN coverage is explored by changing the limiting range of particle velocity. By comparing the different flight speeds, the experimental results show that the setting of inappropriate flight speed will reduce the network coverage. Therefore, setting the proper flight speed is of vital importance in the practical application of particle swarm optimization.

articleTitle: The Design and Simulation of Real-Time Encryption Algorithm for Mobile Terminal Voice Source
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of real-time transmission system of mobile terminal voice source, the paper chooses chaos encryption algorithm based on conversion table with better real-time and security. Because of the security problems of Logistic mapping, the improved Logistic mapping is used as pseudo-random number generator (PRNG) of the algorithm, then the method of generating chaotic binary sequences and the encryption algorithm are improved. The results of simulation show that the security and real-time of the algorithm can meet the real-time transmission system of mobile terminal voice source.

articleTitle: Research on Personalized E-Learning Based on Decision Tree and RETE Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Guidedby the personalized learning theory, artificial intelligence and data mining technology, this essay has put forward an E-learning system that supports personalized study. Firstly, Use the decision tree algorithm to study the classification of learners, and then send the classified learner model to the reasoning network. Lastly, in order to meet the decision support demands of personalized learning environment, this paper has carried out deep research into RE TE algorithm, and describes its use method in personalized learning environment. The system can intelligently provide the corresponding decision support according to the classified learner model.

articleTitle: Oscillation Center Migration Law in Multi-Frequency Out-of-Step Oscillation Scenario
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: With the increase of the scale of AC / DC power grid and the operation mode, the applicability of out-of-step splitting devices based on the two machine model is seriously challenged. The migration law of out-of-step oscillation centers in multi-frequency out-of-step scenario is in urgent need of study. In this paper, based on the equivalent three machine system model, the multi frequency oscillation center voltage and position function are derived, voltage characteristics of multi-frequency oscillation center and the law of oscillation center migration when the system parameters change are analyzed, and research shows that migration scope and direction of oscillation center are jointly determined by the power potential amplitude ratio, the angular velocity and initial phase of power potential, while variation of angular velocity influences the migration speed of the oscillation center. The three machine system example is used to verify the influence of system parameters on the oscillation center migration in multi-frequency out-of-step scenario.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Node Importance Based on Information Theory in Cyber-Physical System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The Cyber-physical system (CPS) will soon become the basic technology of contemporary industry, which consists of two interacting networks where the cyber network overlays the physical network. Due to the high interdependence, the CPS are more fragile in general when facing attacks. In order to avoid the occurrence of catastrophic accidents while taking into account the cost of construction, it is critical to find and protect key nodes whose failure will lead to serious cascading failures. In this paper, we present a way to evaluate the node importance in CPS based on information theory, where node states are treated as discrete random variables, and their importance is interpreted as the information gain. After research, we find that self-information of a node state can reflect its ability to influence the whole system. In particular, the result of this method is affected by the probability of attacking nodes, which helps to assess the node importance in different scenarios and environments.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Leveling Device of Suspension and Elevation Type
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Gravity will be used for unloading in process of deploying solar wing of spacecraft, antenna and other large components. At present, the device which is most widely used is two-dimensional zero-gravity unfolding rack in type of plane sliding rail. As for disadvantages of two-dimensional zero-gravity unfolding rack in type of plane sliding rail such as large space occupation, low leveling efficiency of sliding rail and relatively single applicable conditions, one high-precision automatic leveling device which can be suspended high in plant and can be extended and rise and fall is proposed. The device can be used as an installation platform of two-dimensional plane sliding rail and thus rapidly realizes height determination and fine tuning of levelness for two-dimensional plane sliding rail. Firstly, it is the introduction to system composition; secondly, description is carried out for principles of lifting, principles of fine tuning of levelness and principles of gap elimination so as to ensure that the platform conforms to requirements of height adjustment and levelness precision adjustment; thirdly, analysis is implemented for freedom degree of the device and measures for posture alignment are put forward; finally, installation and test of the device is completed and the results show that: the leveling device can be used to rapidly realize height increase and decrease as well as automatic leveling of levelness; the lifting precision is above 0.3mm and the leveling precision is above 0.028mm/m.

articleTitle: The Security Analysis of Popular Instant Messaging Applications
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Instant messaging applications on the smartphone platform have been prevalent in our communication with each other over the past few years. Meanwhile, people pay more and more attention to conversation security and personal privacy. In this paper, we present a comprehensive security analysis of three representative instant messengers including WeChat, WhatsApp and Telegram. We explicitly demonstrate their air interface communication protocols and the underlying security mechanisms. Furthermore, the encryption principles in local storage of chat records are also analyzed particularly. Besides, we exploit that personal metadata of communication participants will be collected by these instant messaging applications. These metadata closely relevant to personal privacy are almost disregarded in the previous research.

articleTitle: Explore BeiDou Satellite Navigation System in the Application of Electric Tools
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Due to the late start of electric tools in China and the technical blockade of developed countries, China's electric tools have weak functions, weak performance, and lack of brand and product innovation capabilities. With the rapid development of industrialization and informationization in the world, the competition of electric tools industry is becoming more and more intense, and new demands are put forward for the development of electric tools in China to adapt to the competitive market. This study introduces the basic components, functions and advantages of the beidou navigation satellite system, discusses the application of the bilateral real time data transport, accurate positioning, safe and reliable data transmission, short message communication, etc on electric tools, and elaborates the significance of the value and the development prospects of beidou system applied in the field of electric tools.

articleTitle: Open Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Instrument Research for Intracranial Detection
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Patients with traumatic brain injury are difficult to be moved and the patients cannot get prompt treatment, but the real-time detection can be carried out for the intracranial disease. Changes of moisture content in brain can represent the severity of cerebral edema directly. This paper presents an open nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) system for brain edema detection. It can detect the moisture content in different positions of the brain by measuring NMR signals at different depths in target area. After demonstrating the optimal selections of the main magnet and radio frequency (RF) coil, a printed circuit board (PCB) of bilayer splayed coil and its capacitor matching circuit are made, then an open NMR system is established. Using flour and cosmetic cotton in the magnet target area as samples, the NMR system's reliability and accuracy are proved through experiments. Experimental results show that the system designed can detect moisture content in the object at different positions, and consequently for real-time detection of cerebral edema. Due to the system's portability, miniaturization, and low cost, it can provide experiment support for further application of open NMR instrument in clinical.

articleTitle: Research on Coverage Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networks Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In view of the data acquisition oriented coverage and energy consumption problems in wireless sensor network, a coverage optimization method based on improved particle swarm algorithm is proposed. The algorithm is based on the improved particle swarm algorithm to compute the location of the nodes, and according to the coverage quality of network monitoring area, the reasonable mobile nodes are selected. Simulation experiments show that this algorithm uses less work nodes and can satisfy the demands of network coverage, while reduce the blind area, it also can effectively reduce the energy consumption of the whole network, prolong the survival time of the network.

articleTitle: Research on Formation Control of Multiple Autonomous Underwater Vehicle Systems with Limited Communication
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: With the expansion of marine exploration, the application of a single AUV can't meet the requirements of operations on broad sea area, and therefore multi-AUV formation control becomes one of major research directions. In order to address the problem of the limited communication faced by multi AUVs' cooperation in the large scale, this paper proposes a conductor formation mode in which the conductor is equipped with a high-precision sonar system for observing the mobility of other AUV and the surroundings, and the commander establishes a one-way communication with each AUV to maintain its formation. This method not merely can control navigation trajectory of the entire formation, but also greatly reduces the communication energy consumption. Finally, the simulation results prove the algorithm feasible and effective.

articleTitle: AnEffective Design for Fast Query-by-Humming System with Melody Segmentation and Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: A melody segmentation scheme based on pivotal points combined Deep Auto-Encoder (DAE) for Query-by-Humming (QBH) systems is investigated. In order to deal with personalization of human voice, especially the instability in rhythm, we adopt a joint melody segmentation and encoded features extraction method. Pitch sequence between pivotal points shows characteristic differences largely due to monolithic deviation on tones, dynamic diversification in vocal range and mutative scale of tempo. The pivotal points in melody involve extreme and some extreme midpoints which depict the global trends, simultaneously exhibit robust to humming melody. Based on feature extraction, a novel melody segmentation scheme is derived to solve the problem. Through the trained DAE from the deep learning, the deep level coding features in melody are acquired. The experiment results are carried out to demonstrate the validity of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of Thermal Characteristics of High-Speed Precision Grinding Roll
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Grinding head is a core component of high-speed precision roll grinder, and its performance affects directly grinding performances of the whole roll grinder. Aiming at a kind of grinding head of high-speed precision roll grinder, its structure characteristics and heat source characteristics are analyzed, and its thermal properties of the heat source parameters is calculated. On these bases, the finite element method is used to analyze the heat-structure coupling from the high speed roll grinding head. Analysis results show as follows: owing to the heating power consumption, the temperature of grinding head is within 50°C, thermal deformation of the spindle is smaller, and it meets design requirements, so structure design of the grinding head is reasonable. Owing to bearing temperature rises with the increasing of the working time, and in order to avoid oil film failure under high bearing temperature, constant temperature control demand for the hydraulic oil supply system is put forward.

articleTitle: Network Vulnerability Assessment Based on Attack Graph
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In order to identify the vulnerabilities and their relationships, a network vulnerability assessment model and method based on attack graph is proposed. The attack graph model is formally defined, and then the CVSS scaling of the vulnerability is introduced to quantify the attack overhead and return on the path. Based on the quantitative value and network connection relation, the generation algorithm of attack graph is given, and the process of generation, transfer, diffusion and aggregation of network risk is simulated. Compared with the traditional attack graph generation algorithm, the average speed is increased by 18%.

articleTitle: Design of a Low Conversion Loss Mixer Integrated Driving Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: A low conversion loss mixer integrated driving amplifier is designed and fabricatedby using O.5pm GaAs process. The circuit mainly consists of three sections: mixing section, balun and driving amplifier. The RF/LO frequency range of the designed mixer is 4 to 7GHz and the IF bandwidth is DC-2.5GHz. The chip achieves a conversion loss of less than 8.2dB. LO to RF isolation is greater than 34dB and LO to IF isolation is greater than 27dB. Input 1dB compression point is higher than 10.5dBm and input third-order intercept point is higher than 20dBm. The mixer employs a ring-diode and a spiral balun structure, which maintains a small chip area while achieving ultra-low frequency conversion loss. The overall size of the chip is 1.1 mmx l.2mm.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality Simulation of Dust Accumulation on the Surface of Solar Panel
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Dust accumulation on solar photovoltaic (PV) panels has been one of the major concerns, as the accumulated dust on the surface of PV module can significantly decrease the amount of solar irradiance reaching the cells. In the literature, there have been quite a few studies to build analytical or empirical models to understand the impacts of dust on solar power generation, but few studies have been conducted to “observe” and thus model the process of how dust gets to solar cells in the first place and appreciate the major ambient factors that could impact dust accumulation. This paper attempts to bridge that gap by building a virtual reality (VR) model that immerses users into an environment surrounded by solar panels; all perceived environmental factors, such as the sunlight illumination, external force on dust particles, have been considered to render the dust accumulation effects over any time scale of choice. The real-world environmental data, over the course of 30 years, obtained from NREL, are fit into the VR model, and the dust accumulation effects can be visualized. This work clearly demonstrates how latest VR technologies can play a central role in manipulating and displaying a large set of long-term, complex, incomplete, and irregular data.

articleTitle: Borderless Interface for User Authentication Method Tolerant Against Multiple Video-Recording Attacks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this study, we discuss a language-independent interface for user authentication methods focusing on the personal identification number-entry method which is abbreviated to PIN-entry method. It is a basic method and occasionary used as a remedy when other authentication methods fail. For user authentication, tolerance against shoulder surfing or video-recording attacks is the main research objective. In these years, researches have followed two major approaches: (1) the usage of haptic information and (2)the usage of auditory information while secretly transmitting information from the system to the users. The usability of the system depends on how to transmit secret information to the users. This study discusses authentication using auditory information. The interface of a system using auditory information should not depend on a certain language. This study proposes an authentication method using sound, which is independent of any specific language. The conventional methods using vibrations are also independent; however, they require long operation time. In the proposed method, the system that requires rather short operation time, and maintains concrete tolerance against multi video-recording attacks, where its interface does not depend on a certain language, is developed. Such a system could have widespread application all over the world.

articleTitle: Research on Trajectory Planning Algorithm of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Based on Improved A* Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In the research of UAVs'trajectory planning algorithm, the path of unmanned aerial vehicles should be calculated according to the known information of terrain, physiognomy, obstacle, threatening, and etc, as well as flight capability of itself before executing mission and accomplish the mission by tracking the path. An improved A * algorithm combined with the performance and mission of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) is proposed, and the algorithm is applied to solve the problem of avoiding threat of UAVs in known dangerous environment, a method of trajectory planning algorithm of unmanned aerial vehicle was studied at the condition of considering comprehensively influence factors of route cost and threat cost. A numerical simulation in reference route planning of UAV s demonstrates the correctness and effectiveness of the improved A* algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Virtual Machine Migration Algorithm for Cloud Data Center
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of computer technology and network technology, cloud computing develops rapidly. Virtual machine migration is an important means of managing in cloud-based data centers. Two virtual machine migration models are constructed in this paper, the dynamic double threshold hotspot decision model and the destination choice model based on matching degree taking the availability of cloud data center services and the reduction of energy consumption into account. Based on the proposed model, a dynamic double threshold hotspot host decision algorithm and a destination host choice algorithm based on matching degree are adopted to guarantee the service quality of the cloud data center and reduce its energy consumption. At the same time, the algorithm of selecting the maximum relevant virtual machine is implemented. Finally, the classical migration algorithm and the algorithm proposed in this thesis are simulated on CloudSim. throught the comparison and analysis of the results, it is proved that the algorithm proposed in this paper can guarantee the service quality of cloud data center and reduce energy consumption greatly.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Data Center Load Balancing Technology in Campus Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Based on the current development of data center, it is found that data center transmission technology will affect the transmission performance of data center network, and then use load balancing technology as its new transmission technology. And then, the load balancing technology is introduced, including its concept, working principle and application occasions. Next to a campus network as an example, load balancing technology is used to improve its network transmission performance in the construction of its data center, and the data is analyzed by using the data before and after. The results show that the load balancing technology can reduce the CPU occupancy, shorten the corresponding time of the client, while too many concurrent users in the case, each request processing time is shortened, did not cause a certain network congestion, performance has been greatly improved.

articleTitle: Analysis of 3D Reconstruction of Large-Scale Architectural Scene Based on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Aiming at the rapid modeling of virtual reality large-scale architectural scene, this paper designs a method to reconstruct large-scale architectural scene by virtual reality. The method uses the advanced high frequency laser to carry on the solid scanning of the large construction scene, realizes the quick captures of the scene characteristic, and achieves rapid establishment of 3D model of the large-scale architectural scene through a certain feature extraction and logical projections. Experiments showed the effectiveness of the method, and proved that the use of virtual reality for 3D reconstruction of large-scale architectural scene can effectively solve the problem of modeling speed.

articleTitle: Step-Impedance Resonator Bandpass Filter with Wide Stopband Using Coupling Control
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this letter, step-impedance resonator (SIR) bandpass filters with wide stopband utilizing coupling control are presented. The general theory on coupling control is firstly studied, and two coupling structures based up uniform-resonators (UIRs) to suppress spurious resonances are summarized. Then theory on coupling control of SIRs is given, good rejection level and miniaturization could be realized simultaneously in filter designing. Two second-order parallel-coupled line bandpass filters with different schemes are designed and fabricated, one filter shows wider stopband beyond 14f0, the other with one open-stub shows better rejection over 30dB with stopband beyond 12f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>.

articleTitle: Algorithm Design of Wearable Pedometer
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of wearable devices, this paper improves the main step counting algorithm, and adds the functions of computing and displaying the data such as velocity, mileage and calorie consumption. The algorithm mainly includes the step algorithm of human motion data acquisition and gesture analysis, the filter algorithm based on Fourier decomposition, the filter algorithm based on mean value algorithm and the energy consumption algorithm for calories. These algorithms are written through the core processor. And single chip microcomputer will collect the calculated movement steps, mileage, current calories consumption and other motion data through Bluetooth components to the mobile phone, to achieve the monitoring of human movement. It has the characteristics of high precision, low redundancy and rich function.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation Based on Prospect Theory in Cloud Manufacturing Environment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In cloud manufacturing (CMfg) environment, a wide range of manufacturing resources are integrated through the network, to provide customers services with high-quality and low-cost safely and reliably. The problem of resource allocation in cloud manufacturing environment is the combination optimization problem of manufacturing tasks to resource providers. Considering the expectations of different customers, we have proposed an integer non-linear programming model based on prospect theory. An improved genetic algorithm has been put forward to solve the model. Moreover the results of the numerical examples show the effectiveness of the approach proposed in this paper in terms of the quality of solution.

articleTitle: Predict Atmosphere Electric Field Value with the LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: lightning is a common meteorological phenomenon. Warning lightning is very important for protecting the safety of human beings and industrial infrastructures. Fluctuation of the atmosphere electric field value is closely related to the lightning's approaching. So the time-series data of atmosphere electric field can be used to warn the lightning. LSTM is one kind of the recurrent neural network, which could deal with long term information dependency. Here LSTM is applied to predict the atmosphere electric field, which help to warn the lightning. The real monitoring data from Jiangsu Province is collected, and three prediction experiments are designed to compare LSTM prediction performance. Finally, the results show the direct prediction could get accurate short term prediction value. The rolling prediction losses accuracy because of the error accumulation. The interval prediction gets satisfactory prediction with regards to accuracy and warning time.

articleTitle: A Binary Approximate Naive Bayesian Classification Algorithm Based on SOM Neural Network Clustering
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Although the classification performance of Naive Bayesian algorithm is relatively good, the time complexity and spatial complexity of the algorithm are linearly increasing with the increase of data volume. In order to reduce the complexity of Naive Bayesian algorithm, a two - point approach naive Bayesian algorithm combining SOM neural network clustering is proposed. Firstly, the SOM neural network clustering algorithm is used to reduce the number of classes in the original data set, and the spatial complexity of the Naive Bayesian classification algorithm is reduced. Then, by using the dichotomy approach, Conditional probability approximation operation, the time complexity of the classification algorithm is reduced. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can reduce the time complexity and spatial complexity of the algorithm under the premise of ensuring the classification accuracy of the algorithm, and improve the classification performance of Naive Bayesian algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Classification Model of Equipment Support Personnel Based on Collaborative Filtering and Xgboost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: With the intensity of war, the improvement of the complexity of information technology and equipment, the demand for equipment support personnel is getting higher and higher, and the professional division of labor needs more and more clear, but the professional knowledge and maintenance ability of each equipment security personnel have a greater difference. The task is more and more sophisticated, but the equipment security personnel is limited, which made a new demand of equipment support personnel in accordance with the ability to classify and match the staff, ability and task automatically. From the point of view of data mining, we find the relationship between data and ability, task and ability, and provide accurate and convenient personnel classification method for the future combat. According to the method of capability classification, we use collaborative filtering and xgboost algorithm to carry on the classification model of equipment support personnel. The results show that the error of classification decreases with the increase of data volume. At present, when we collect more than 300 samples, the error is 0.04.

articleTitle: Modeling Background Knowledge for Privacy Preserving Medical Data Publishing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Currently, many privacy preserving schemes for medical data publishing faces the potential threats of background knowledge based attacks, however, the principle of the attacks has not been fully studied. How background knowledge impacts on the privacy disclosure for various of privacy preserving schemes is still a new research topic to be solved. In this paper, we study the background knowledge based attacks and propose a model to quantify background knowledge which is used to infer patient privacy. Besides, we simulate three popular anonymity algorithms (K-anonymity, L-diversity, t-closeness) on sample datasets and testify our background knowledge attack model. We believe that our research could help us to understanding the impact of background knowledge on privacy inference of published medical data.

articleTitle: Research on Video Ratings Prediction and Survival Analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Aiming at the poor accuracy of the existing Internet video ratings prediction, this paper proposes a self-correlation prediction based on the view amount and a survival analysis scheme based on the video component factors. The self-correlation prediction scheme uses BP neural network and autoregressive moving average (ARMA) to predict the short video, and a multi-direction hybrid prediction method based on the ladder data to predict the long video. The experimental results show that the prediction accuracy of the above methods can reach up to 90%. The survival analysis scheme adopts the COX proportional hazard model (COX model) to analyze the correlation between the component factors of the variety shows and their ratings, then predicts the ratings according to these factors. The experimental results show that the concordance index (C-index) can be up to 0.8.

articleTitle: Low-Latency Mapping Algorithm for Network-on-Chip
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: As a new generation of SoC design scheme, Network-on-Chip (NoC), is being adopted by more and more chips as communication architecture. In this paper, the N oC mapping problem is studied, and a low latency NoC mapping algorithm is proposed to reduce N oC communication latency in mapping specific applications to the N oC architecture.
