The algorithm reduces the communication latency by balancing the link load of the IP of NoC which associate the individual tasks. The experimental results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper reduces the execution time of N oC by 20 ~ 40% and 10%, respectively, compared with the sequential mapping and simulated annealing algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Scheduling of Software Cloud Testing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The rapid development of cloud computing technology has made it possible to make software testing low-priced and specialized for many companies, solving the bottleneck of software enterprise development, making the enterprise pay more attention to the design and coding. The test resources are arranged in the cloud. It solves the problem that some software testing resources are not effectively utilized, and also matches the demands of funds, personnel and technology in some enterprises. In this paper, the problem of the cloud test resource scheduling is studied. It is verified by HP Cloud Test Software Platform, and it is shown that the algorithm is efficient.

articleTitle: Research on the Fuzzy Algorithm of Path Planning of Mobile Robot
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In recent years, the development of mobile robot is very fast, which has gradually penetrated into all fields of human life. Path planning is an important part of the intelligence of the mobile robot. Aiming at the problem of path planning of mobile robot in complex environment, a fuzzy control algorithm is designed in the paper. We use sensors to obtain obstacle information and target information, and control the speed of the left and right drive wheels of the mobile robot by fuzzy controller, so that the robot can go straight or turn intelligently. A reasonable path is planned by the fuzzy algorithm in the paper. Simulation results show the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm for the path planning of mobile robot.

articleTitle: Clustering Multivariate Time Series from Large Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In recent years, as the sensor technology develops swiftly, a large number of sensors can be deployed to form a sensor network. Massive data are generated from large sensor networks. It becomes an interesting problem to cluster high-dimensional multivariate time series from large sensor networks to discover the hidden regularity. In this paper, we propose a new method to cluster the high-dimensional time series. In our scheme, the output of the sensors are treated as gray values of images. Then, new image features (BSF, Bipolar Sigmoid Feature) and the chain similarity are presented to measure the similarities of time series. Finally, the hierarchical clustering method is used to discover data patterns. The effectiveness of our method is evaluated on the Twin Cities traffic data. In the experimental results, it displays that there are three regular patterns in the weekday data and two patterns in the weekend day.

articleTitle: Soil Moisture Monitoring System Based on Ziggbee Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: To improve the utilization rate of agricultural irrigation water, a soil moisture monitoring system based on ZigBee technology is designed to improve the complexity and high cost of the traditional wired network. The proposed system has the characteristics of low consumption, large capacity, high security and easy integration with combing the advantages of ZigBee ang WIFI. This system uses the Z-Stack protocol stack of TI company, takes the CC2520 chip as the core, and includes the STM32 MCU of TI company. This system can greatly improve the water use efficiency and keep the soil moisture in the optimum range of plant growth.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technique of Screen Spot Authenticity Detection Based on ARPA Ground- Based Radar
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, the target information is obtained from the original radar image based on the ER rule, that is, the ship target recognition is needed for the spot in the radar image. In practice, it is necessary to discriminate the authenticity of the target from the difference feature of the radar spot in the continuous image. Through the E-R rule algorithm used in this paper, the recognition accuracy of ship target can reach 76.65% in ship target, coastline and waterway buildings, and the recognition accuracy of shoreline and waterway buildings is 92.27%. In this paper, based on the ARPA shore-based radar spot recognition accuracy of the target has been improved, the Yangtze River Delta region ship automatic identification is of great significance.

articleTitle: Research on the Hybrid Algorithm Based on Differential Evolution and Genetic Algorithm for Mixed Model Assembly Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This paper proposed a hybrid of genetic algorithm (GA) and differential evolution algorithm (DE) for actual mixed model assembly scheduling. This hybrid algorithm comprehensively integrates the advantages of the GA in the effective processing of discrete variables and that of the DE in the effective processing of continuous variables. The computer simulation results demonstrated that the proposed hybrid algorithm has a higher convergence rate, stronger optimization ability, and better reliability in mixed model assembly scheduling than the traditional algorithms. This algorithm can also significantly improve the optimization and computational efficiency of multi-parameter and highly nonlinear problems.

articleTitle: Operation Status Evaluation of Elevator Based on Cloud Theory and Evidence Theory
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, an evaluation model based on entropy method, cloud model and evidence theory is established to solve the problem that the evaluation result of the elevator operation status is too subjective. By analyzing the primary features associated with the operation status of the elevator, a layered evaluation index system for elevator condition assessment is built. Firstly, the entropy method is used to acquire the constant weights of each indicator, and the variable weight model based on balance function is introduced, in which the constant weights is modified to get the variable weights according to the deviation of actual data and normal value. Then the cloud theory is applied to achieve the conversion between quantitative index and qualitative concept, in which the membership degree is obtained so that index is mapped to each status. Lastly, based on the evidence theory, the index information is fused, and the evaluation results are obtained by the principle of maximum membership degree and reliability criterion. By applying the model we proposed, the example analysis shows that, the model is correct and effective, which could reflect the operation status of the elevator accurately.

articleTitle: Application of Hammering Method Modal Testing in Larger Structure
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Hammering method modal testing has economic, convenient and efficient advantages, etc., which is widely used in the small structure modal analysis. However, the application scope is limited in the larger structure due to small excitation energy, weak response signal and other factors. In the paper, a series of measures to improve the precision are adopted in the larger structure aiming at some missile, thereby accurately obtaining modal parameters at former four orders, and realizing the application of hammering method modal testing in larger structure.

articleTitle: Improved SPSO-based Parameter Identification of Solar PV Cells I-V Model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The paper considers the parameter identification of PV cells' I-V model. Based on the nonlinear equation of PV cells I-V experimental model, which cannot be used directly to analyze the parameters' value with the output current and voltage, we present a quasi-linear differential equation of dV/dI to turn the parameters to differential coefficient of the dynamic relationship of I-V. Then an improved Simplified Particle Swarm Optimization (SPSO) algorithm is proposed to identify the unknown differential coefficient in the equation, by which the optimal parameters of PV cells can be calculated. Lastly, the results of PV cells' experiment verify the validity of the improved SPSO algorithm and shows that the identified parameters, which are affected by irradiance, can be used to get a more accurate PV cells I-V model to predict PV power generation.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Real Time Warning Module for Bank Financial Supervision System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The construction of a scientific and effective supervision of the commercial bank accounting risk early warning model for early identification and early warning of the risk of banks, taking timely measures to prevent and resolve risks, and preventing the risk of spreading have important practical significance. A real time bank accounting supervision system model of early warning module design method is proposed based on multiple discriminant. Software development and design of early risk warning system of bank accounting supervision are analyzed. Bank accounting supervision system of real time warning module is composed by the network communication module, data acquisition module, bus transmission module and warning program loading module. The system adopts embedded design, realizes the online risk warning for bank accounting supervision through the analysis and control of user behavior, the risk early warning module software accounting supervision system with embedded Linux technology is developed, build a credit risk, interest rate risk, accounting supervision of banking risk exchange rate risk prediction and alarm multivariate discriminant analysis model, real-time early warning and information classification of bank accounting supervision system through the boot loader, to cause a bank in the business activities of various expenses and the interest payments, accounting for business payments, and regularly according to the provisions and requirements into the form of financial statements. Bank financial analysis and risk measurement is obtained. The results show that the bank accounting supervision of the system can realize the real-time risk warning, and it can improve the bank's risk prevention and management ability.

articleTitle: Bi-Directional LSTM Recurrent Neural Network for Lumbar Vertebrae Identification in X-Ray Images
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Duo to the capability of providing online patient pose, mobile C-arm X-ray images play a key role in image-guided minimally invasive spine surgery. However, automatic lumbar vertebrae identification is still a challenge task because of the inherent limitation of mobile C-arm. In order to solve these problems, a novel automatic lumbar vertebrae identification method is proposed, which based on bidirectional long short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network (RNN). First, in order to solve the problem of lumbar vertebrae texture overlapping in X-ray images, the curvature features of 3D lumbar vertebrae model, which are common to the 2D X-ray images, are taken as the input of the model. Second, in order to simulate the multi-view imaging of intraoperative C-arm, the bi-directional recurrent neural network is exploited to learn the correlation of lumbar curvature features at different imaging angles. Finally, in order to avoid of gradient vanishing and error blowing up, the LSTM neuron is applied to replace the notes of bi-directional RNN. Experiment results show that our method identified lumbar vertebrae more accurately than another two methods.

articleTitle: Various Channel Models in Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Wireless communication technology profoundly affects each person's life; channel model has become one of the research hot spots in the trade union in the wireless communication system. This article firstly expounds three kinds of fading channels: large-scale fading, small scale fading, and SISO channel model in wireless communication system, then simulates the impact of distances to the path loss in different channel models through MATLAB, and lastly concludes the full text.

articleTitle: Modeling of Heat Supply Heating Load Based on LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The central heating system structure is complex, and there are serious hysteresis, strong coupling, nonlinear characteristics, Aiming at the problem that it is difficult to identify through mechanism modeling, a modeling method of heat source energy saving control for central heating system based on LSTM neural network is proposed. A heat supply load modeling method for central heating system is established by using LSTM neural network, to predict the backwater temperature of primary heat source, the neural network model is built by using Tensorflow as the calculation framework, compared with the traditional BP neural network modeling, the simulation results show that the heat source model established by LSTM neural network is better than the BP neural network model, and can effectively improve the modeling accuracy and model generalization ability, meet the demand of heat source heating load modeling. After analysis it can be concluded that the neural network modeling method based on data-driven modeling is more simple and has more reference value than traditional experience modeling and mechanism modeling, and provides an effective method for modeling other complex nonlinear systems.

articleTitle: A Novel Lyapunov Function-Based Nonlinear Controller to Suppress Circulating Current of Paralleled Multi-Inverters
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, a method is developed for solving the problem of circulating current in paralleled multi-inverters and a model is proposed to formulate the relationship of the output active/reactive power and phase/amplitude of inverters' output voltage. A nonlinear controller is designed to apply the change of active/reactive power to calculate the phase/amplitude of the referred voltage, which governs the output current of every inverter. Based on Lyapunov function, we design a novel nonlinear control law to track the referred current and suppress the circulating current. Finally, the validness and effectiveness of the proposed controller are verified by a simulation experiments using MAT LAB platform.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of a Low-frequency Vibration Isolator
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, a compound low-frequency vibration isolator is designed. The vibration isolator combines magneto rheological (MR) inerter with shape memory alloy (SMA) spring to achieve low-frequency vibration isolation effect. The MR inerter can change values of inertance and damping by regulating the magnetic field strength and flow area, while the SMA spring can reduce the dynamic stiffness of the system via its superelasticity. The theoretical model of vibration isolator is established. The influence of different parameters on the vibration isolation performance is simulated and the force transfer ratio is calculated. The results show that the isolator with intelligent materials can effectively isolate low-frequency vibration.

articleTitle: High Frequency Dielectric Property of Transmission Lines Ice
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Icing transmission lines might cause a disaster to the power systems security and reliability. The deicing method using current skin effect at High frequency may be an effective measure for the transmission lines icing. The dielectric property of ice affects the ice temperature rise under alternating electric field. This paper focuses on the ice dielectric property under the different frequency current. The method of measuring dielectric constant is analyzed., a measuring dielectric constant method using the special LCR digital electric bridge and automatic anti-interference of dielectric loss instrument is proposed. By measuring the ice sample from different regional place and apparatus as insulator., and bus of the transmission lines from south China., the relevance between the transmission lines icing dielectric property and frequency is discovered. The experiment results show that the sample's dielectric constants rise in a certain extent compared with pure ice, and the dielectric loss enlarges at the range of lkH to 100kHz, and reaches the maximum value at about 10kHz. This study result is of important support for the principle of high frequency excitation melting ice to the transmission lines ice.

articleTitle: Design of Tunnel Lighting Arrangement and Intelligent Control System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Highway tunnels have the advantages of saving traffic land, improving traffic efficiency and shortening the mileage of highway. With the increasing of highway tunnels in China, the proportion of energy consumption of tunnel lighting in transportation energy consumption is getting heavier and heavier, and it has a lot of room for improvement [1]. Aiming at the shortcomings such as large energy consumption, high maintenance cost and single function of tunnel lighting system in China, this paper designs a set of concrete measures and schemes for energy saving and intelligent multi - functional transformation of tunnel power supply lighting equipment. According to the tunnel lighting specification [2], On the one hand, the use of LED energy-saving lamps in the tunnel and the rational arrangement of the reflective walls on both sides of the tunnel walls, without reducing the effect of tunnel lighting under the premise of reducing the number of lamps in the traditional program. On the other hand, the hardware is based on C/C++ programming language to control the entire lighting system has achieved energy-saving effect.

articleTitle: Study on the Method of Intelligent Maintenance Simulation Based on the Fusion of Human Motion Data
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: At present, the virtual maintenance simulation technology is still cumbersome operation, time-consuming, and lack of precision. How to quickly and efficiently simulate has become a common concern for the simulation developer. Considering the limitations of the application of immersive and non-immersive simulation environment range, we fuse the human motion capture data and the simulation animation data collected in two simulation environments and propose the intelligent maintenance simulation method cooperatively controlled by two kinds of data source in the DELMIA simulation environment, which can fleetly generate the new virtual human maintenance activities and realize intelligent and efficient virtual maintenance simulation. Finally, a maintenance case is used to verify the method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Sensor two Level Fusion Algorithm Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Data fusion technology is the key technology of wireless sensor network, which Can reduce the amount of transmission of the sensor data; which can significantly improve the network's perceived performance, extend the network life cycle, reduce the time delay. Multi-sensor data fusion can obtain more accurate information than single sensor. This paper estimates the monitoring variables from the measurement data with noise, proposes a multi-level fusion algorithm based on the neural network. Simulation results show that the fusion results of the proposed algorithm are better than the mean value estimation algorithm and adaptive weighted fusion algorithm in precision and fault tolerance, which Can better adapt to the requirements of data accuracy in today's large data environment.

articleTitle: A High-Precision CMOS Temperature Sensor
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, a high-precision temperature sensor designed by a standard 0.18μm CMOS process with 3.3-V power supply is presented. The CMOS temperature sensor mainly consists of a bandgap reference (BGR) circuit and a SAR ADC circuit. In the BGR circuit, not only the traditional first-order compensation technique is adopted, but also a high-order curvature correction technique is used to obtain two accurate reference voltages, which are adopted as reference voltages for the SAR ADC, and a twice emitter-base voltage of BJT is used as a temperature sensing voltage for the SAR ADC. Simulation results show that temperature coefficients of two reference voltages are as low as 1.16 ppm/°C and 3.66 ppm/°C over a temperature range of 165°C (-40°C to 125°C), PSRRs are up to -100 dB at low frequency. The CMOS temperature sensor achieves 0.1°C temperature resolution, and ±0.35°C absolute accuracy.

articleTitle: Investigation of Viterbi Algorithm Performance on Part-of-Speech Tagger of Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Many tasks of NLP need to preprocess the words and sentences because it can make the future work convenient. Nowadays, the demand of POS tagging is increasing. POS tagging is an efficient method as preprocessing tagging, even meaningful in text to speech, syntactic analysis and machine translation. When it comes to the POS tagger, they need to know every word POS. It is available for human because it is easy for us to describe it. But when we increase the count of words to the million number, it is not possible to make people do POS tag. In this paper, we introduce Viterbi algorithm to help computer do the better job in tagging lexical categories. Viterbi algorithm is an algorithm that used dynamic programming to solve the POS of sentence. As we know, the word is sensitive about the position of the word. The POS of the word is related about the nearby words. We make simulations about how Viterbi Algorithms work in POS tagger and get the accuracy performance.

articleTitle: Sparse Measurement Matrix Design and RIP Prove Based on Compressive Sensing in WSN
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The Compressive Sensing (CS) is an effective method on data collection, transmission and processing in wireless sensor networks. One of hot research points in CS is to design a kind of measurement matrix that satisfies Restricted Isometry Property (RIP). In this paper, a measurement matrix is designed depending on the analysis of sparsity in CS and the features of sensing nodes. The effort is to design sparse matrix with the least incurred computational cost and less storage space when it maintains quality of signal recovery. The design approach is based on the properties of combinations. And, an optimized proof method of RIP is proposed in this paper. The method can simplify the prove process. Finally, the rationality of the matrix and the effectiveness of the method are discussed through theoretical analysis and simulations.

articleTitle: A Two-Step Approach for Underwater Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Underwater photography is important for the works of exploring underwater scenes. Comparing with normal camera images, the underwater images usually have low brightness-contrast and with low visual quality. This paper proposes a new method to improve the underwater image visual quality by using a two-step approach. Firstly, a transmission map based enhancement is applied to increase the image global contrast, similar to the image defog algorithm. Secondly, image details are extracted and the local contrast is improved by applying edge-preserving filter. Experiments demonstrated that the proposed two-step approach can significantly improve the visual quality of underwater images.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Vehicle Suspension Performance Based on Simulink
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Suspension system is an important mechanical structure for the vehicle to achieve stability and ride comfort. The performance of the vehicle suspension system directly affects the ride comfort and handling safety of the vehicle. The traditional passive suspension system design parameters once optimized to determine the dynamic changes cannot be made, it is difficult to make the car has a good ride comfort. The semi-active suspension composed of the elastic element and the damped damper has the advantages of low energy consumption and easy realization, and can improve the ride comfort and operation stability of the vehicle. Semi-active suspension not only overcomes the shortcomings of passive suspension system, but also reduces the cost of implementation and becomes one of the research hotspots in automobile technology. Based on the analysis and analysis of the existing research results, this paper takes the semi - active suspension system of the vehicle as the research object and establishes the mathematical model of the two - degree - of - freedom 1/4 - car semi - active suspension. On this basis, the PID control system of semi-active suspension is successfully established, and finally the simulation of the system based on MATLAB/Simulink is carried out. Finally, the design model is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Network Virtual Laboratory Based on ASP.NET
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, we conduct research on the design and implementation of computer network virtual laboratory based on ASP.NET. Virtual laboratory is a kind of special, distributed problem solving environment which is to provide the users a web-based experiment teaching, technical exchanges, joint research and collaborative work platform which is a kind of virtual prototype system based on computer science research and engineering design. In our system, the necessary structures are discussed with sufficient introduction. The result shows the effectiveness of the approach.

articleTitle: Analysis of Sea Clutter Characteristics at High Grazing Angle
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The analysis of sea clutter statistical characteristics is very important for establishing a sea clutter model that can approximate the actual sea clutter as much as possible. In this paper, we systematically analyze the sea clutter characteristics including the time correlation, spatial correlation and Doppler characteristics of the measured data at 70° grazing angle. The results show that the influence of the correlation difference between clutter and the target can not be neglected at high grazing angle in Ku-band high-resolution situation. It also shows that the stronger the energy of sea clutter in certain distance unit the more relevant the spatial correlation is and the influence of the radar platform and the antenna speed on Doppler spread can not be neglected.

articleTitle: Optimizing Fruit Fly Algorithm to Solve TSP Problem
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Traveling salesman problem is a classical combinatorial optimization problem. Based on solving TSP problem, this paper presents an an optimized fruit fly algorithm. Based on the fruit fly algorithm, the fixed step size is reduced to a decreasing step size, which makes the global optimization ability and local optimization ability form a dynamic balance mechanism. The crossover and mutation operations combined with genetic algorithm not only protect the optimal individuals, but also increase the diversity of the population, and restrain the generation of premature problems. Finally, using the basic fruit fly algorithm and the optimized fruit fly algorithm to solve the TSP problem, it is proved that the improved fruit fly algorithm has better performance in solving the TSP problem.

articleTitle: Sparse-to-Dense Depth Reconstruction Using Non-Convex Optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Depth reconstruction aims at recovering accurate depth maps from sparse measurements. Recent works reconstruct depth maps based on the assumption that neighboring pixels have similar depth when they have similar color values. However, such methods tend to blur depth boundaries due to color bleeding. We address this problem by a non-convex penalty. First, we formulate depth recovery problem as a non-convex optimization problem in which depth boundaries are preserved by an L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>-L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> penalty. Second, we solve the problem based on iteratively reweighted least squares. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art algorithms in terms of PSNR and visual quality.

articleTitle: Curavture-Aware Non-Negative Matrix Factorization for Clustering
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Nonnegative matrix factorization (NMF) is one of the most successful techniques in pattern recognition and computer vision. The main advantage of NMF is the parts-based representation of the input, which is consistent with how the human brain recognizes objects. On the other hand, the high dimensional data usually resides on a low dimensional manifold. The performance of the standard NMF can be significantly improved by incorporating with the manifold regularization. However, most existing manifold methods fail to take the extrinsic geometry into account, i.e., how the manifold embedded in the original high dimensional data space, which can discriminative the proximal points from different clusters. In this paper, we propose a novel algorithm, named curvature-aware nonnegative matrix factorization (CANMF), to explicitly consider the extrinsic geometrical structures of the data distribution. First, we build an affinity graph to encode the intrinsic geometrical structure of the data. Then, an anisotropic diffusion process is utilized to exploit the extrinsic curvature, which rescales the weights of the affinity graph by the diffusivity operator. Thus, the weights from different classes can be compressed, and enhance the discriminative ability of the proposed CANMF. The experimental results on several real-world datasets show the advantages of our algorithm.

articleTitle: An Image Classification Algorithm Based on HSV and 2-D Maximum Entropy Model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: A 2-D maximum entropy model is proposed to overcome the weakness of BOVM (bag of visual words) histogram which always neglects the image color information. The 2-D maximum entropy mode of a class of image is built by H component and S component in HSI color space, and what's more, the corresponding 2-D maximum entropy distribution is the bottom reference feature vectors, which is used to match with an input image by Euclidian criterion in image classification algorithm. Experiments has illustrated that the algorithm presented in this paper has a higher image precision than the classification algorithm based on BOVM.

articleTitle: Test Case Generation Method for Multi-Objective Harmony Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Test case generation is a multi-objective problem, because the test case generation goal is to cover multiple test objectives, but the basic harmony search algorithm can not solve the multi-objective optimization problem. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a multi-objective harmony search algorithm for generating test cases (MOHS). This method is based on the characteristics of the multi-objective optimization algorithm and the multi-harmony library competition strategy, which accelerates the search speed of the optimal solution to expect the algorithm to improve the scale of the optimal test case set. Finally, the algorithm is compared with GA, SA, PSO algorithm, and it is proved that the algorithm has certain advantages in scale, convergence algebra and execution time.

articleTitle: A High-Security C Language Code Generation Method for Synchronization Language
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In the modern society, with the rapid development of the aerospace field, the requirements of the software system in such field are extremely improved. Such systems show features in both areas of safety critical real-time system and the reactive system, which means that the system has to interact with the external environment uninterruptedly in base of high safety and reliability. Synchronization language can support formal verification which is suitable for the description of deterministic concurrency behavior, providing a completely solution for such system. At present, synchronous language is widely used in software development of aerospace field. By using such methods, we can better construct software models in aerospace field. However, existing researches have paid little attention to the generation method from the synchronization specification to the support of cross-platform parallel code. The conversion and implement between synchronous language and C language heterogeneity is complicated. In this paper, we propose a high-security C language code generation method for synchronous language. For one thing, we use the closure topology sorting algorithm (CTSA) to generate C code, and guarantee the correctness of the code. For another thing, we also generate C language code based on the Security Subset of GJB (China Military Standard) to ensure the security and reliability. Finally, we successfully complete the C language code generation of flight control subsystem based on aerospace field, and verifies the correctness and validity of the method.

articleTitle: Application of Improved GA and GANN in Signal Feature Selection and Classification
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In order to select feature and classify signals better, the paper introduced the F-Ratio rule, and improved the GA (genetic algorithm). It introduced multi-populations parallel and competition strategy into GA, used F-Ratio rule as fitness function of GA, and used adaptive genetic operator to improve the GA. On this basis, the paper optimized neural network (NN) by GA. Experimental results for three radio signals showed that the proposed methods can more effectively select the subset of signal features, and have better classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Three-Dimensional Fast Location and Application Platform of Internet of Things Based on Local Information Characterization for Global Distribution Density Information
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In recent years, the Internet of Things has been widely concerned with the comprehensive application of various sensing technologies. The amount of data handled by the Internet is huge compared with any previous network, showing a real sense of mass. Wireless sensor network is an important part of the Internet Things, and it has become one of the research hotspots in the realization of the target technology. As a result of many factors such as environment, obstacle, network attack and hardware error, the data is easy to produce large errors, and the formation of erroneous data has a serious impact on positioning. Although there have been a number of positioning algorithms and models, but for the wrong data to achieve positioning research is also rare, especially in the country, almost blank. In order to solve the above problem, this paper proposes a new method for locating the global distribution density information with local information by using the network topology information. The typical local correlation model of robust local analysis is similar to the existing typical. In the real environment, the optimized algorithm has higher localization robustness and stability compared with the experimental results in the real environment.

articleTitle: Optimization of ESS Based Damping Control Using Electric Torque Method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: As smart-grid technology develops, the energy storage system (ESS) is widely used. By controlling exchange of either active or reactive power between ESS and power system, power system's damping and dynamic performance can be improved. Aiming at meeting the requirements of online applications of Wide-Area damping control, this paper adopts Electric torque analysis (ETA) to realize the analysis of small signal stability of power system. Based on the two-machine equivalent system, this paper explores the definition of the ETA method, as well as its mathematic relationship with the MA method, and the condition of stability. An online optimization scheme of ESS is presented, which is based on damping control, to maximize the damping torque coefficient with the synchronizing torque restraint. Finally, the paper uses a 4-machine-2-area benchmark to verify the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed optimization method.

articleTitle: Saliency Detection of Underwater Target Based on Spatial Probability
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Due to the complex underwater optical environment, it is difficult for the classical detection algorithm to detect underwater targets accurately. A new underwater saliency detection model, inspired by the visual attention system of the human, is presented. First, the image is segmented into super pixels using the SLIC (simple linear iterative clustering) method and color region contrast feature is extracted based on them. Then, the target geometric center is located using Harris corner detection operator, it is used to describe the target space distribution feature in the form of center probability and all of the features are fused by the way of adaptive target location. Last, an optimizing saliency method is reported to highlight the foreground and weaken the background based on target space distribution feature, in addition, it encourages continuous saliency value using space smoothness. Experimental results show that the method reduces the influence of underwater noise and complex background on target detection effectively, and improves the validity and accuracy of target detection in underwater environment.

articleTitle: Automatic Assembly of Eccentric Shaft Component Based on the Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: An assembly strategy based on the machine learning algorithm is proposed to cope with the difficulties in the practical assembly of eccentric components in high-precision RV speed reducer. The simplified models of eccentric shaft hole are built to analyze the possible contact states in the process of assembly. Subsequently, the basic principles of the machine learning algorithm are introduced, and a shaft hole assembly method with supervised learning is put forward. At last, the platform for assembly robot is constructed and tested with force characteristic information, and the test results indicate the good effect of this assembly strategy.

articleTitle: Design of Millimeter Range High Precision Ultrasonic Distance Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the main error sources of ultrasonic distance measurement, a millimeter-range high-precision ultrasonic distance measurement system was developed. The STM32 processor was used as control core of the system. We chose 200 KHz transmitting-receipting ultrasonic transducer and increased the environmental temperature compensation and back wave gain compensation. Meanwhile, the study proposed a method without additional hardware circuit which using STM32 processor to measure the pulse width of the echo wave, correct the lag time of the echo and further improve the accuracy of measurement. The experimental results demonstrated that ranging accuracy was less than 1mm in the range of 1000 mm with the conditions of using air as medium and existing the good reflective object. The system has simple and reasonable structure, with good stability, convenient measurement, high precision and could be suitably applied to the field of high precision measurement.

articleTitle: An Improved Fruit Fly Optimization Algorithm Incorporating Average Learning and Step Changing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: To overcome the disadvantages of slow convergence speed, easily relapsing into local extremum and poor stability of traditional fruit fly optimization algorithm (FOA), an improved FOA incorporating Average Learning and Step Changing into the evolutionary process (AL-SC-FOA) is proposed. The combination of strategies of average learning and step changing can balance the ability of global search and local search of the algorithm, accelerate the convergence speed, improve the accuracy and enhance the stability of the algorithm. The proposed AL-SC-FOA is applied to six standard examples of the optimization test. The experimental results show that the AL-SC-FOA can avoid falling into the local optimum, which has higher precision and faster convergence speed, as well as better stability.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of a Novel Audio Jamming Technique
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: A noise jammer is designed in this paper. By transmitting ultra-low frequency (ULF) signals, it can directly block the receiving component of the audio sensor, saturate it and deprive it of the ability to extract and restore the received audio signal, without inflicting any damage on the human and environment. An appropriate source of noise is chosen and modulated in different ways to guarantee that the modulated noise is absolutely irregular. An effective transmission method is adopted to maximize the transmission distance, coverage of frequency spectrum and the level of saturation.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Multi Serial Port Communication Based on Map-Reduce Technology
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of computer technology, the demand for online monitoring in modern industrial enterprises is on the rise. In order to effectively meet the actual industrial field requirements of the serial communication capacity and quality, some technical treatment can be taken. On the one hand, multi-serial port software technology is used to realize serial communication concurrent operation; on the other hand, multi-thread technology is adopted to realize the reasonable allocation of serial communication resources. Firstly, the multi-serial port software communication architecture is established; secondly, by the multi-threaded means, to the communication resources of the serial port is optimize; finally, based on Map-Reduce technology, the multi-level mapping association between the communication data and the communication serial ports is established. The simulation results show that the multi-serial communication which based on the Map-Reduce technology not only improves the efficiency of multi-serial communication, but also effectively integrates multi-serial communication redundancy data.

articleTitle: Image Super-resolution Reconstruction via Multi-Frame Defocused Images
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Defocused images are often neglected due to visional blur. While, they also contain valuable target information. Reconstructing high resolution (HR) image from the defocused images is a challenge especially when the point spread function (PSF) is unknown. Aiming at the problem, an image super-resolution reconstruction method based on PSF estimation is proposed. According to the image degraded model, we establish the cost function of PSF and utilize the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm to estimate it. In the image reconstruction process, the method of image block reconstruction based on compressive sensing is adopted and a blurring matrix without edge effect is constructed which solved the problem caused by large image size. Experimental results show that the algorithm can accurately estimate image PSF and the reconstructed HR image has high peak signal to noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity (SSIM).

articleTitle: The Design and Implement of Monitoring System for Mushroom Greenhouses Based on Intelligent Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the increasing development of the Internet of Things and intelligent agriculture, the application of Internet of Things technology in traditional agriculture has entered a new level. The great value of intelligent agriculture in the marketplace has been fully endorsed by the government departments and the groups from all walks of life. A new remote intelligent mushroom greenhouse control system based on ZigBee technology is putting forward to this paper. The system not only improves the efficiency of production and automation of the greenhouse, but also allows growers to monitor the environmental factors in agricultural production through the mobile network anytime and anywhere. In this system data and commands are transmitted through ZigBee and 3G/4G, which not only realize higher efficiency for the real-time monitoring of multiple greenhouses, but also effectively improve the degree of intelligent mushroom greenhouse environment control. The main function model of the platform is realized by Java core technology, and the cluster and configuration of Hadoop are putting forward to prove the availability and reliability of the platform. The system runs well, and it has a certain guiding significance for the project development of Intelligent Agriculture.

Author Keywords: the monitoring system for mushroom greenhouses

articleTitle: A Cascade Tracking Algorithm Based on Artificial Beacon and HOG Features
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Nowadays, Correlation Filter-based trackers are unable to deal with several situations, such as motion blur, fast motion, occlusion and scale variation. This paper proposes a new adaptive cascade tracking algorithm based on artificial beacon and HOG features for mobile robot. For details, system with RGB-D camera and Bluetooth device is used to solve the problem of scale variation within a certain distance. And the adaptive factor is used to reduce the cumulative errors caused by occlusion and fast motion. To show the superiority of this algorithm, five different types of video sequences from CVPR 2013 visual tracking test are selected to compare with other five kinds of Correlation Filter-based algorithms in the experiments. Simultaneously, experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is robust to the complex environment. In the end, the application of the algorithm for mobile robot has also achieved good results.

articleTitle: Application of Powell-HS Algorithm in Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: For effective image classification and classification of image database expansion in the correct rate is not high, this paper proposes an image classification method based on LSSVM and Powell-HS algorithm, this method used the test function to test the Powell-HS algorithm and the search efficiency is high; then using KPCA to extract the image features of the samples as LSSVM model the input, and compared to the other 3 methods, the results show that the new method is applied to image classification, and the classification accuracy has been greatly improved.

articleTitle: Automatic Keyword Extraction Method for 3GPP Technical Standard
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In the patent infringement testing work, keyword extraction for the 3GPP technology standard has been both the key point and the difficulty in the examination of communication patent. In order to improve the retrieval quality of 3GPP technical standard and reduce the labor cost. Based on the analysis of the characteristics of 3GPP technical standard, Firstly, a method based on word frequency-document entropy to extract the universal words in the 3GPP technical standard is proposed, and then the algorithm of extracting the candidate keywords based on the dependency syntax analysis tree is proposed. After filtering the candidate keywords, the position feature, the word co-occurrence feature and the context semantic feature are used to calculate the weight score of the candidate keywords, and the dynamic thresholds are calculated according to the weight score range of the candidate keywords in each technical standard. Finally, dynamic thresholds are used to determine the result. Experiments show that the method has achieved higher correct rate and recall rate than the traditional keywords extraction method, and also proves the validity of three different features when extracting different numbers of keywords.

articleTitle: Simulation of Turbofan Engine Based on Dynamic Specific Heat Method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The component-level mathematical model of a turbofan engine is established by the dynamic heat method, which is solved by N-R method. The throttle characteristics of the engine are simulated. The results show that as the engine rotating speed increases, the engine thrust gradually increases, and the sfc reduces at first and then rises, which are consistent with the actual work of the turbofan engine.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Computer Network Vulnerability Assessment System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology and network technology, the network speed is increasing fast, the expansion of computer network and data transmission medium can easily lead to network outages, an accurate assessment for the vulnerability of network should be made to ensure the safety and stability of the network. The design method of evaluation system for fragile control with dynamic connection structure of network topology design and bus system based on computer network, the dynamic connection structure of network node routing repair, computer network system and I/O service operations can be upgraded and dynamic connection patch mode. Network applications using the B/S structure of the operating system vulnerability assessment, the system bus control method to configure network reset serial receiver and transmitter configuration, send and receive control register and check the remote network system available on the service And configure, operate directly on the database application using cross compiler, network operating system architecture editor, compiler, connection and debugging, realize the network vulnerability assessment system. Test results show that this method of computer network vulnerability assessment, it can effectively repair the network routing and interrupt node, improve the connectivity, the safety and stability of the network.

articleTitle: Application of Wavelet Packet Decomposition in Denoising of Motorized Spindle Vibration Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Vibration analysis is a common method for accuracy monitoring of the motorized spindle. However, vibration signal acquired in factory contains lots of noise, not only high-frequency noise, which is generated by bearings and motor, but also low-frequency factory noise. This paper used wavelet packet decomposition method for denoising. Both the simulation and the experiment proved that the proposed method can effectively improve the denoising quality.

articleTitle: Architecture Design for a Four-Way Pipelined Parallel Texture Engine
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Texturing is an indispensable functionality of GPU. To against the texture look-up operating speed and texture memory bandwidth problem, this paper presents a dedicated hardware architecture of texture engine for 3D graphics engine based on OpenGL 3.0 and GLSL 1.40 with a number of novel features, such as an optimized full-purpose four-way pipelined Parallel texel data formatters and filters, multi-port multi-bank non-blocking texture cache. The design of the texture engine is synthesized under SMIC 40 nm CMOS process technology. Performance evaluation results show that the design can achieve up to 33 fps for 1024×768 resolution at 150 MHz and is efficient for real time rendering.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Interprocedural Def-Use Relationship
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method based on the technology of interprocedural data-flow analysis to build and construct the use-def relationship using Definition Expression, and then analyze and model the data-flow between processes using the technology of function summary. This information is essential to cluster the similar inspection points reported by static testing tools, which can greatly improve the efficiency of manually defect confirmation.

articleTitle: Global Optimization of Welding Parameters Based on Improved EGO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Residual stress generated in welding process lead to fatigue failure. Therefore, it is important to optimize welding process for improving fatigue life of weld parts. As the traditional optimization and simulation results are liable to fall into local optimum or more iterations about model. In this paper, improving the global optimization of kriging-based is proposed to find the optimum welding parameters for maximum residual stress. Based on the initial sample, Kriging model is implemented to approximate the objective function regarding the design variables. the introduce of calibration points about MAXEI and maximum variance MSE, Kriging model is updated iteratively by adding two new points to the original sample till the global optimum is obtained. The results show that the proposed method has faster convergence, reducer the iterations and it can search for a more global optimal solution. Applying the method to design optimization of residual stress generated in welding process can better guide designer of welding process planning.

articleTitle: Influence of Hybrid-driven Method on the Electromagnetic Properties of Electromagnetic Motor
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In the light of electromagnetic motor driving system, electromagnetic con-version characteristics and structural principle were described. Electromagnetic drive and hybrid-driven method were proposed; the mathematical models describing the two drive systems which have adopted the magnetic circuit analysis method were established, starting with a discussion on how the drive system affects the electromagnetic force and air-gap magnetic flux density. Under the same conditions, the electromagnetic drive and hybrid-driven model was respectively simulated to reveal the impact on the electromagnetic force and air-gap magnetic flux density due to the different driving mode. Variation of the electromagnetic force with increasing coil current of two types of drive systems under motor speed control is studied preliminary. The results shown that compared to pure electromagnetic drive system, the hybrid drive system electromagnetic force raised from 2198N to 4097N, the airgap magnetic flux density increased from 1.048T to 1.393T; the electromagnetic characteristics of the magnetically driven motor are improved effectively.

articleTitle: Modeling and Design of Real Gear Tooth Surface for Internal Honing Ring
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The nature and quality of internal honing ring have a direct impact on the machining precision, machining efficiency and quality, directly affecting the internal gear honing processing technology. Based on the principle of strong internal meshing gear honing, we adopt the reverse design method to quickly and accurately establish the standard work piece of the real tooth surface model using surface modeling technology. Secondly, the application of generating method principle makes the standard work gear and internal gear honing wheel cutter blank generate motion, enveloping internal honing wheel tooth surface model. Then, according to the internal gear honing machining principle, we use the honing wheel tool after envelope, obtaining workpiece after cutting gear honing. Finally, the overall error analysis of standard work piece gear and the honing cutting work piece gear is made. The accuracy can meet the design requirements and the method can be used in the tooth surface design of high precision honing wheel.

articleTitle: Method of Electric Energy Alternative Potential Analysis Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: “Electric energy alternative” strategy promotes electric energy consumption instead of scattered coal and oil burning in energy end-use link to ultimately achieve fundamental change of energy development. In order to provide theoretical guidance for power supply, power grid and capacity planning, an analysis method of potential of China's electric energy alternative based on support vector machine and particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed. Main factors affecting process of electric energy alternative are defined based on multi dimension data, fitted with cumulative electric energy alternative using support vector machine method. Parameter selection of support vector machine is optimized with particle swarm method, and effective prediction of cumulative electric energy alternative is realized. Simulation results show that this method can significantly improve prediction accuracy, having guiding significance for supporting potential analysis of electric energy alternative.

articleTitle: Research on Abnormal Data Mining Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This paper mainly discusses the commonly used outlier mining method, and gives the definition of abnormal data. According to different classification types, different types of outlier mining methods are classified, then several of the more commonly used outlier mining algorithms were introduced, a variety of outlier mining algorithms have their own application standards.

articleTitle: The Calculation of Equivalent Electrical Parameters of Buildings in Shortwave Band
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The buildings near urban shortwave stations can generate great effects that cannot be neglected on the propagation of radiation electromagnetic wave of antenna. In view of these effects, we must finish the equivalent treatment of different structures of buildings by substituting them with materials with equivalent dielectric constant while modeling.

articleTitle: An End-to-End Image Retrieval System Based on Gravitational Field Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, we design an end-to-end image retrieval system based on deep convolutional neural network (DCNN). Compared with the traditional method of using the deep convolutional activation features as the feature vector to match the image, we simplify the process of the algorithm and improve the problem of `semantic gap' in the content-based image retrieval system. We first build an image matching database based on the gravitational field model, that is to add a similarity score label for each image in the database production phase. We then train the improved deep learning model and verify the effectiveness of the algorithm on the common image matching database (Caltech-101) and Holidays). Finally, the experimental results show that our improved deep learning model that used for image retrieval has excellent image matching ability. The overall retrieval accuracy inCaltech-101 and Holidays is 88.5% and 94.1 %, respectively. As the number of returned images increases, the retrieval accuracy of the system decreases slightly and eventually becomes stable at a high value.

articleTitle: The Numerical Simulation Analysis for Temperature Field of the End Plug Hole Welding by Sysweld
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This paper uses Sysweld simulation software to simulate the temperature field of the end plug hole welding and explores the melt of plug welding parts at different welding current. Then it compares the results with the actual gold phase diagram and verifies the reliability of the calculated results, so as to obtain the welding current in accordance with the production requirements.

articleTitle: A Method of Aircraft Detection Using Fully Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Traditional methods on aircraft detection in remote sensing images rely on handcrafted design, which is difficult to detect and recognize the target in complex scenes and multiscale conditions. In this paper, we tackle these two problems by proposing a method for aircraft detection based on the fully convolutional neural network(FCNN). FCNN can obtain the location of the aircraft quickly and directly by minimizing a multi-task loss. Through data augmentation and transfer learning, the classification accuracy of FCN is much improved. In order to recognize small targets, we combine the resolution information with priori knowledge of aircraft to construct image pyramid structure on the test images. The experimental results show that the method with less parameters has higher accuracy and the model is simple to train.

articleTitle: Research on Airflow Pressure Distribution Characteristics of Exhaust Port in Tank Armored Vehicle's Engine Compartment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Analysis of airflow in engine compartment is the important contents in the development of tank armored vehicles. According to the test requirements of tank armored vehicle under the actual working conditions like inconvenient assembly and electromagnetic interference, we finished the research and design of the airflow pressure distribution characteristics measurement system of exhaust port in tank armored vehicle's engine compartment. And we finished tests of engine compartment under the poor working conditions, which was of great help to the measurement of tank parameters. We accomplished the assembly of the measurement system without any damage to the tank body. According to the national standard we finished the design of the quantity, locations and the assembly of the sensors. Meanwhile, there were descriptions of airflow pressure distributions of tank armored vehicle at seven different speeds in this paper, which were a microcosm of airflow pressure distributions with different speeds and different time, and which were then analyzed to reason out the comprehensive airflow pressure distribution characteristics of exhaust port in engine compartment.

articleTitle: Application of a Laser Scanner on Edge Alignment Detection Based on a Bending Robot
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: If the suckers and mechanical arms of conventional bending robot are connected rigidly, then these errors will affect quality of bended steel plate, which will lead to the waste of material. Based on ARM series chips, a laser scanner is applied on the bending robot to detect the edge of steel plate, at the same time the messy stacked steel plates are stacked neatly, so that we could solve the problems that conventional bending robots may meet. Moreover, laser scanner detects fast, it judges whether steel plates are aligned within detecting distance, so it can work in the dusky environment.

articleTitle: Threshold Based Neighborhood Selection for Case-Based Reasoning in Software Effort Estimation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Purpose: Case Based Reasoning (CBR) a widely studied method for software effort estimation (SEE). In this paper, we propose the Threshold based Neighborhood Selection (TNS) method to address the issue of noise and outliers in datasets. Method: Specifically, TNS first learns project similarity threshold from historical projects. Then for a project, neighbors whose similarity with the current project falls within learned threshold are selected for estimation. Results: Experiments on 6 benchmark datasets demonstrates that TNS achieves optimal MAR (Mean Absolute Residual) on 4 out of 6 datasets and second and third optimal on the other 2 datasets. Conclusion: The results prove that TNS is an appropriate method to address the issue of noise and outliers in datasets.

articleTitle: Research on Robust Optimization Design Method Based on Random Probability Test
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In order to improve the robustness and stability of stochastic linear control systems, the robust optimization design method is proposed based on random probability test, quasi linear hyperbolic differential equation of stochastic linear control system is constructed, analysis of quasi linear hyperbolic complex analytic functions of self adjoint perturbations of positive solutions, using Smith feedforward compensation mathematical model of stochastic linear control system the rough set theory, pseudo linear analysis of hyperbolic differential equation stability according to the Bayes theorem, the posterior probability density for the characteristics of the solution, the test method of random probability judgment boundary equilibrium of random line control system, and the method of maximum likelihood estimation is adopted to estimate the optimal control parameters of the control system, control parameter self-tuning qualitative adjustment robust optimization design, the realization of the control system. The mathematical derivation and simulation results show that the robustness of the linear control system is improved with this method, the convergence of the control process is better, the robustness is higher, and the control quality is better.

articleTitle: A Routing Algorithm Based on Partition Sensor Network Scope
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Wireless sensor network has the advantages of low cost, low energy consumption, high flexibility and convenient deployment. It has a wide application market in environment, military, medical and other fields. In the wireless sensor network, LEACH algorithm could cause the waste of node energy due to the cluster nodes are far away from the cluster head and close to the base station. To solve this problem, a partition sensor network scope K-LEACH algorithm was proposed based on the LEACH algorithm. It introduced the distance parameter K. Nodes within the scope of base station as the center and k as the range of radius did not participate in cluster head election rotation, and communicate with the base station directly. The optimal value of k was selected from the experimental results. Through simulation, the analysis compares of the performance between LEACH and K-LEACH algorithm were provided mainly focus on the network stabilization and life cycle.

articleTitle: A Fast Damping Algorithm for INS with External Velocity Reference
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Under the condition of external velocity reference, a fast damping method is proposed for fast suppression of the oscillation error of inertial navigation system (INS). In the method, traditional damping network structure in INS is changed to accelerate the attenuation of the vibration error. In traditional damping network structure, the internal damping method is easy to be influenced by the vehicle acceleration without external velocity reference, while the external damping method has poor dynamic characteristic. So the imposed method increases a forward channel from external velocity to the damping network to compensate the damping error caused by the vehicle acceleration. According to the dynamic process of system damping, the fast damping network parameters is designed and the turnable parameters are input to the damping network considering the dynamic characteristic and error suppression in the damping process. The simulation and test results show that the settling time of the conventional damping algorithm is about 1 hour, which is shortened to 10 minutes by using the fast damping algorithm with the external velocity reference.

articleTitle: Design of High Performance CMOS Logic Circuits with Low Temperature Sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Both absolute delays and delay variations of nanoscale CMOS logic circuits, more than ever, are so heavily dependent on the thermal environment; a logic circuit operating at a high temperature, say 90°C, can see its speed drop to just half of that at 0°C. In this paper, we show two circuit techniques that can be employed to counter such severe circuit performance degradation introduced by thermal effects. First and foremost, temperature-insensitive circuit designs tend to favor implementations that use gates with smaller fan-ins (≤ 4) and have shorter logic paths. Next, the thermal-induced delay penalty can be further reduced by powering logic circuits with temperature adaptive power supplies as proposed in our prior study. Experiments on various benchmark circuits, implemented with a 45nm CMOS technology, have confirmed that, when a single fixed power supply is employed, both absolute circuit delays and temperature-induced delay variations can be reduced by more than 20% as the circuits are implemented using logic gates with small fan-ins and short logic paths. Provided a CTAT -like adaptive voltage supply to replace the single fixed power source, the same circuits will experience even smaller delay variations that fall into the range of 15%~30% for temperature varies between 0°C and 90°C, a sharp contrast to 60%~100% delay variations observed in logic circuits powered by a single constant power supply.

articleTitle: A Copyright Certification System Based on DCT Coefficients and MapReduce Model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a digital copyright certification system based on network which extracts the feature information with DCT coefficients and then stores them in the network servers. This can avoid completely distorting images, however, the cost of computing and network transmission will be increased during checking copyright information. To enhance the computation speed and efficiency of extracting and authenticating feature information, the system optimizes the process of extracting and matching with MapReduce model. After actual sample testing, the system has higher copyright recognizing accuracy and scouting speed, as well as outstanding effect on digital right protection.

articleTitle: The Calibration of Robot Motion Based on Cross Bar
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the end position information is easy and the attitude is difficult to be obtained in the measurement process, a calibration method based on the end position constraint is proposed to establish the linear equations. In this paper, it deduces the problem of degradation of the coefficient matrix in theory, which provides the basis for the selection of structural parameters, and adopts the method of cross bar calibration without coordinate transformation. It verifies the effectiveness of the algorithm by simulation in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Joint Allocation of Bandwidth and Power in Multi-Service Scenarios in DVB Systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the dynamic allocation of power and bandwidth resources by the DVB-RCS system under multi service scene. Firstly, it analyzes the shortcomings of existing multi service queue scheduling strategy and proposes an improved scheme for multi user scheduling policy, which calculates and schedules the user's business and channel environment firstly, then the users' bandwidth and power are distributed together according to the calculation results and the simulation of the algorithm is implemented on the OPNET simulation platform. Finally, we verify the algorithm for the protection of the QoS delay through simulation and compare the impact of algorithms on resource allocation under conditions of different business capacity requests and different channel conditions on resource allocation.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Integrated Logistics Service Based on SERVQUAL Model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The booming of distribution requirements from e-commerce, Internet of Things, Mobile Internet, GIS, GPS, and automation technology have all boosted the logistics industry. A growing number of competitors get involved and the innovation of new business modes has enriched the logistics industry. It is not accidental for major express enterprises to plan their transformation to integrated logistics service operators. But how to evaluate the effect of the transition? This study constructs the evaluation model for integrated logistics service of express enterprises and tests relative hypotheses. The results show that there is a gap between customer expectation and their experience. Furthermore, the gap mainly comes from the process of service delivery, promise and customer expectation.

articleTitle: Improved FP-Growth Algorithm Based on Spark Platform and its Analysis and Excavation in Clinical Data of Lung Cancer
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To mine the core prescription of traditional Chinese medicine for lung cancer medical record. METHODS: Deep FP-Growth algorithm, an improved FP-Growth algorithm, was implemented under the Spark environment and was used to excavate the frequent patterns and association rules of traditional Chinese medicine in the treatment of lung cancer cases. RESULTS: The core prescription of several diseases with higher frequency of occurrence was excavated. CONCLUSION: Deep FP-Growth algorithm based on Spark platform can effectively excavate the core prescription of traditional Chinese medicine in the treatment of lung cancer.

articleTitle: The Design and Analysis of Picosatellite Orbital Deployer Based on Shape Memory Alloy Release
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In view of the current picosatellite orbital deployers generally exist high release impact, and can not achieve the single and regular deployment for satellite, so we design a picosatellite orbital deployer based on shape memory alloy material drive and establish the dynamic model of the collision between satellite and guide rail, considering the high and low temperature environmental factors, the influence of the guide rail clearance on the separate posture of picosatellite is analyzed. An analysis of the mechanical properties and kinematics simulation is carried out. All experiment results show the rationality of the scheme and the correctness of the analysis.

articleTitle: Study on Focal Laws Fast Calculation of Ultrasonic Phased Array System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
