abstract: Focal laws fast calculation is one of the key technologies in ultrasonic phased array (UPA). To improve the real-time of the focal laws applied in the UPA. In the paper, we designed a focal laws calculator by FPGA technology to calculate the time delays for the ultrasonic waves between multi-element ultrasonic sensors attached a wedge and the focus to realize the beam focusing. Allowing the time delays are associated with a series of one-element higher-order equations. And n-time interval search and CORDIC algorithm are further presented for solving the equations to calculate the time delays in real time. Experiments show that the n(n=12)-time interval search and CORDIC algorithm to calculate the focal laws can achieve a maximum relative error value of 0.434% by FPGA technology. The real-time and validity of the focal laws calculator are proved through application of the UPA, which is of great importance significances in engineering application.

articleTitle: Research on Method of Automatic Segmentation of Gray Scale Images Based on Clustering
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Based on Affinity Propagation clustering and BWP index, an image segmentation algorithm is proposed. The proposed algorithm uses BWP index to analyze the validity of clustering results produced by Affinity Propagation clustering algorithm, and to determine optimal number of segmentations. On the basis of optimal number of segmentations, the proposed algorithm produces segmentation results of the gray level image. In order to decrease the time complexity of the similarity matrix and validity analysis, the method is proposed to cluster gray value instead of pixels in gray space and reflect clustering results to pixel space to produce image segmentation results. In addition, a method of using absolute value distance instead of Euclidean distance in BWP (Between-Within Proportion) index is proposed for clustering in gray space. Experimental results of many kinds of images indicate the validity and good performance of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Beam Spreading Effect on the Signal-to-Noise Ratio of Space Optical Chaos Communication System Under Different Wavelength
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Since the chaos optical communication can provide high security at the physics layer, it can be effectively used in the space-to-ground transmission system. The space-to-ground chaotic transmission system is obtained according to the general chaos communication scheme. First, considering the beam spreading effect induced by atmospheric turbulence, a practical model for space-to-ground transmission link is attained. Then the chaos communication is applied to the transmission model. Since the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) can be utilized as a measurement of communication quality, we compute the SNR for the space-to-ground chaotic communication system. Since wavelengths 1550nm, 1310nm, 1064nm, and 850nm are the most widely used in the space-to-ground optical communication nowadays, we conduct simulations to compute SNR for these wavelengths with varying parameters. It shows that different wavelength choices will lead to different susceptibilities of various parameters.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Modulation Methods of the Modular Multilevel Converter for Ship Propulsion
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: A modular multilevel converter (MMC) which can unlimitedly increase its voltage and power levels in the same condition of structured complexity has great potential in the frequency modulation and speed regulation of a ship high-power electric propulsion system. According to the requirement of application, two pulse width modulation (PWM) methods, or carrier phase shift PWM (CPS-PWM) and submodule unified PWM (SUPWM), are selected, and the differences in harmonic level, submodule (SM) switching frequency and program complexity caused by the two methods have been compared. The theoretical and simulation results show that when the number of sub-modules and the carrier frequency meet the requirements of ship propulsion, both of them are equal in harmonic level. And the difference in CPS-PWM SM switching frequency is smaller than that in SUPWM, and the complexity of SUPWM program is lower than that of CPS-PWM program.

articleTitle: Mechanical Analysis and Test Verification for Globe-Cone Joint Assembly of Electric Propulsion Systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This paper investigates the sealing mechanism of the globe-cone joint of the electric propulsion systems. By carefully analyzing the nonlinear finite element model of the globe-cone joint assembly process, together with the engineering experience, the tightening torque range of the globe-cone joint is derived. Finally, the mechanics environment test and the leakage rate of detection are provided to verify and correct the effectiveness of the theoretical analysis results.

articleTitle: Research of Filtering Image Linear Characteristic Recognition Method Based on Improved Hough Transform
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The analysis of the pixel response of the filtered image was the key to solve the problem of target recognition. A kind of method was proposed in this paper which the line characteristic extraction based on pixel window, and the rules of the line characteristic extraction were formulated. The traditional Hough transform was improved and then the characteristic extraction was performed. The computational complexity was reduced and the ability of the straight line to be recognized was improved by this way. The result showed that this method could extract the straight line target from the image of the filter response pixel through the simulation.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Multi-Level and High-Dimensional Feature in Sample Space
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Multivariate statistical analysis is often used in fault diagnosis. PCA is a commonly used multivariate statistical analysis method, based on the threshold method for fault diagnosis. But the PCA is the original space of the equivalent that didn't increase any amount of information, often resulting in a lot of minor failures difficult to diagnose. Deep Learning has a successful application in pattern recognition, linear representation of detail based on multi-level network. But Deep Learning is not explainable, only to give training results and there is no theoretical basis. On the basis of the original PCA, firstly expands and then reduces the dimension. The former is intend to fully express the information which cannot be expressed in original space by adding a projection, two projection,..., on the basis of original projection, and so on. And then generate a multi-level projection frame representing the space from the sample space high-dimensional feature. Experiment shows that the minor faults that cannot be detected in the original projection space can be detected under the projection frame of the new multi-level high-dimensional feature, and the detection rate of fault detection is improved.

articleTitle: A Numerical Method for Nonlinear Systems Observability Calculation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Based on the theoretical calculation of the observability of nonlinear dynamical systems proposed in literature [1], a new numerical method to calculate degree observability is developed, which connected the observability conception to time delay embedding by numerical approximation. This method solves the problem that the original method can not be employed without system equation. It expands the applied field of degree observability and takes into account the impact of noise. Simulation results show that, when only the measurement data is presented and the system equation is unknown, the new method is still able to achieve the right result.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Heterogeneous Access Networks Based on SDN for Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet of Things (IoT), more and more communication access networks are connected to the IoT network. However, the large number of these access networks and the access mode is complicated, the existing quality of service (QoS) guarantee methods can not satisfy the requirements of heterogeneous access network. This paper proposed a software defined distribution optical network architecture (SD-DON) and an access method for QoS guarantee by utility function. Numerical results verified the performance and reliability of QoS guarantee method of heterogeneous access network.

articleTitle: The Research on Time Synchronize Security Technology for Electric Power System Based on Beidou
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: feature extraction; learning (artificial intelligence); neural nets; optimisation; pattern clustering; particle swarm optimisation; wireless sensor networks; object detection; probability; and security of data.

articleTitle: Research on the Machining and Control Principle of a Fast Servo Used in Noncircular Piston Turning
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Piston is the core component of the car engine, its shape is designed as middle-convex and varying ellipse (MCVE) to adapt to the harsh working conditions. In order to accomplish surface machining of the MCVE piston, the key technology is a fast tool servo (FTS), which can meet the requirements of high frequency response, small-range tool motion and high precision. In this paper, the machining principle and force modeling of noncircular piston were analysed firstly, a feedforward and feedback mixed PID control strategy was proposed, the PID controller that based on the mixed PID control strategy was designed and embedded in the motion controller, at last, verification experiments were carried out, the contour accuracies of all these experiments met the design requirements, it can be concluded that this control strategy is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Sparse Channel Estimation Based on Improved BP-MF Algorithm in SC-FDE System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: A low complexity sparse Bayesian channel estimation algorithm was proposed for SC-FDE receiver. The proposed algorithm firstly applies the combined belief propagation and mean field (BP-MF) algorithm to the Bayesian Hierarchical Prior Model and obtained by approximating some BP messages using generalized approximate message passing (GAMP) algorithm. Then we put the channel estimated values that are acquired from the first iteration in such an order-from big to small and further reduce the computational complexity, we eliminate some small value to achieve this goal. Finally, we applied the MF method to the Frequency Domain Equalization. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed method has nearly the same performance as compared to the MF algorithm in estimation precision of the channel and Bit Error Rate (BER) while it has much less computational complexity as compared to the MF algorithm.

articleTitle: A Variant SIRS Virus Spreading Model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In allusion to the situations of incomplete immunity and immune failure, this paper presents a novel propagation model. Its epidemic dynamics behavior on different networks is been studied with the mean-field theory. The theoretical analysis and experimental results indicate coexistence of incomplete immunity and immune failure can greatly accelerating viral transmission and expand the scope of infection. Meanwhile, this paper found the peck which occur in the initial stage of transmission can be effectively curbed by loading the contrapuntal immunization strategy.

articleTitle: Optimization of Environmental Monitoring Sites in Shenyang City with WRF/CALPUFF Model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Owing to the rapid industrialization and urbanization in Shenyang City, the original environmental monitoring sites can not obtain a value representative of a standard index, which can reflect the current pollution condition in the city. On the basis of the distribution of industrial sites in Shenyang City and the surrounding region, three environmental monitoring sites should be changed and two new environmental monitoring sites must be constructed to cover the increasing number industrial plants and the expanding area. In this study, a California Puff model was coupled with the Weather Research and Forecasting model to better evaluate the changes in the environmental monitoring sites. The five environmental monitoring sites were determined by comparing the temporary monitoring data in the period of April 16-24, 2015, and the p, which means correlation coefficient, of the four meteorological fields, namely, wind speed, surface temperature, relative humility, and surface pressure, reached 0.53, 0.91, 0.63 and 0.72, respectively. In the evaluation of the optimized results, the values of NMBF2 were much better than those of NMBF1, with the average recorded NMBF2 values for SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub>, and PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</sub> at 0.35, 0.85 and 0.70, respectively.

articleTitle: Wide Band Sonar Signal Processing Based on Wide Band Correlation Ambiguity Function
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: With the development of new type of transducer, the available bandwidth of sonar systems continues to expand. Wider bandwidth means more benefits in range and velocity resolution. However, with the expansion of bandwidth, the narrow band condition cannot be satisfied any more, and a wide band signal processing method should be introduced. In this paper, wide band processing method based on wide band correlation ambiguity function is reviewed, and simulation shows the advantages of this method in wideband signal processing, simulation results also show the benefits of extend bandwidth.

articleTitle: Improvement of Network Security Situation Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: With the extensive application of computer networks, the importance of network security is particularly prominent. In order to accurately evaluate the state of network security, based on the acquisition of artificial immune network, the hierarchical network security situational awareness method based on IDS alarm log is used to optimize the network security situation. At the same time, in order to accurately predict the network security situation, the Kalman filter algorithm is used to optimize the gray model to predict the network security situation. The experimental results show that the gray model optimized by Kalman filter is more accurate and the reliability is better.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Double Nozzle Flapper Gas Servo Valve
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In order to study the performance of double nozzle flapper gas servo valve theoretically, it is necessary to establish accurate mathematical model of gas servo valve. Considering the nonlinear factors of the gas servo valve, this paper establishes a nonlinear mathematical model of the gas servo valve in the working process, and the simulation of the gas pressure and the piston movement of the gas servo valve is carried out. The simulation results show that the established mathematical model is consistent with the actual model, and can be used to analyze the static performance and dynamic performance of the gas servo valve, which plays a guiding role for the improvement of the structure of the gas servo valve.

articleTitle: Interpolation Method for the Positioning Results of the Snapshot Receiver
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This paper describes the interpolation method for satellite navigation positioning results. In order to reduce energy consumption and ensure positioning accuracy of the snapshot receiver, we analyze and compare the accuracy and real time in the interpolation of satellite navigation positioning results through the experimental data, summarize the different interpolation methods and the appropriate order number for different requirements. According to the calculation, the 4-order Hermite interpolation should be selected under the condition of the maximum positioning precision, and the 4-order Lagrange interpolation should be selected if we want to balance the real time and accuracy. The 4-order Lagrange interpolation should be selected under the maximum real time condition, but in this case, if we want to balance the real time and accuracy, the 4-order Hermite interpolation should be selected. This paper is of guiding significance to the improvement of Global Navigation Satellite System snapshot receiver.

articleTitle: Application of GIS Grid Interpolation on Unconventional Resource Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Take Amu-Darya basin as an example, the paper applies GIS grid interpolation to resource evaluation for the tight gas in the middle and lower Jurassic. It is characterized by integration or interbed between source rock and reservoir, thus a good matching relationship has formed. There are the geological conditions of developing a large area of dense sandstone gas reservoirs, which are mainly concentrated in the center of the depressions and the slopes. According to the drilling, logging, seismic and sample experimental data, including porosity and reservoir thickness of the tight gas reservoir, TOC and maturity of hydrocarbon source rocks, classification standard of the tight gas resource evaluation are put forward. Through multigraph of the source socks, reservoirs, caps and the sedimentary facies, upper and lower “sweet spot” of the lower-middle Jurassic are predicted and divided into I, II, III favorable zones. The contour maps of abundance for recoverable resources of Amu-Darya basin are formed through spatial graphic interpolation of key assessment parameters of tight gas resources on the Geographic Information System (GIS) platform. Results show, tight gas geological resources of upper and lower “sweet spot” of the lower-middle Jurassic, respectively, 3472×18m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>,2749×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, The tight continuous gas reservoir in the stabilization zone of the Amu-Darya basin has great exploration potential, but the economic recoverable resources are low.

articleTitle: Chinese Web Short Text Subject Clustering Based on Similarity Upper Approximation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a Web short text clustering method based on altered Similarity Upper Approximation algorithm. After the initial text modeling, we reduce the dimension of the text feature word matrix by singular value decomposition. After the clustering is completed, we extract the most frequent words in each text cluster to represent the subject of each cluster. The clustering process does not need to specify the number of clusters in advance, and it is suitable for Web short text clustering that is constantly updated and can not know the specific number of clusters in advance. In order to make the cluster number more accurate, we proposed to add the merger of clusters based on the average similarity of clusters and outlier detection in the original algorithm. Experiments show that the altered algorithm proposed in this paper is superior to the K-means algorithm and the hierarchical clustering algorithm in clustering accuracy and more accurate to original algorithm in cluster number.

articleTitle: Start-Up Process Identification Model of a Turboshaft Engine Based on SVM
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The modeling principle of the identification model of a certain turboshaft engine is analyzed, and the set of parameters for the model training is selected and identification model training sample set is composed by a large number of engine starting process bench test data. The feature space parameters of the support vector machine regression model are optimized by genetic algorithm. The identification model of a turboshaft engine starting process is established and verified, meanwhile the starting performance is estimated and analyzed. The results show that the speed of the gas generator is basically stable after 40 seconds, and the fitting of the measured data with the regression data is very good, the root mean square error is about 0.5%, and the square correlation coefficient is greater than 0.99, very close to 1. Among the free turbine speed and gas generator outlet temperature fitting effect evaluation index, the mean square error is about 0.3% and 0.6%, respectively, and the square correlation coefficient is more than 0.98 and 0.96, both are very close to 1. So the accuracy of the identification model can meet the needs of engineering applications.

articleTitle: Research on Hyperchaotic Encryption Algorithm Based on MapReduce
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of data security in big data environment, a hyperchaotic data encryption algorithm based on big data platform Hadoop is proposed. The dynamic behavior of hyperchaotic system is more complex and its sequence has better characteristics of randomness. Therefore, it is more suitable for data encryption. Combined with parallel programming model MapReduce, a secure and efficient chaotic cryptosystem is designed by using a four-dimensional Lorenz hyperchaotic system. Experimental results show that the efficiency of the proposed algorithm is better than AES. Meanwhile, in security aspect, the algorithm has excellent characteristics of large key space and good key sensitivity.

articleTitle: Narrowband FMCW Micro-Motion Target Imaging Method Based on DCS
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the traditional radar rotor target imaging method isn't suitable for FMCW radar when Doppler ambiguity happened, a narrow band FMCW rotor target ISAR imaging method based on distributed compressed sensing(DCS) is studied. First, the rotor's echo range cell is extracted, and the rotor rotation speed is estimated through self-correlation method and minimum image entropy method. Then, the narrowband FMCW distributed sparse representation is constructed, which realizes the final imaging through joint sparse reconstruction. Finally, the simulation results verify the feasibility and validity of the research method.

articleTitle: Study on Statistical Characteristics of Sea Clutter Based on Measured Data with Large Grazing Angle
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This paper presents some theoretical models of sea clutter, including Rayleigh distribution, Weibull distribution, logarithmic normal distribution, K distribution and KK distribution, whose fits are tested with measured data in Ku-band, high resolution capabilities and large grazing angle conditions. The fitting effect of the five distribution methods is analyzed in this paper and the results show that the amplitude of sea clutter is close to Rayleigh distribution in the case of large grazing angle and tail of the amplitude distribution curve of the sea clutter in some distance units deviates from the Rayleigh distribution while the K and KK distributions can fit better.

articleTitle: Application of MTabu in VRPTW
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Membrane evolutionary algorithm is a new computational optimization algorithm based on membrane computation derivation. Its distributed and parallel characteristics have great potential to solve the bottleneck problem in optimization field, especially when solving the traditional algorithm in solving VRPTW problems of poor accuracy. In this paper, taboo search algorithm and membrane computing are combined to solve these problems.

articleTitle: Physical Modeling Analysis Based on Fan Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: For the conventional power system voltage stability study, the voltage instability or voltage collapse is started from the load point of the receiving system. Because the load demand exceeds the limit of the transmission power of the power network, the system has been unable to maintain the balance between the power of the load and the power absorbed by the load. The system loses balance and causes voltage instability. In view of the characteristics of wind power generation, many aspects have been affected by the traditional generator sets to the power grid, and the impact of the grid on the wind turbines has changed. According to the characteristics of wind turbines, it is necessary to study the problems of wind farms connected to power grid.

articleTitle: Research on CSAMT Emission Current Recording System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In controlled source audio-frequency magnetotellurics (CSAMT), we often obtain data through recording transmitted signals by receivers. But in the actual exploration, electromagnetic interference is serious and useful, signals are always contaminated by noise and interference signals. This paper focuses on recording and storing the original emission signal for subsequent data processing simultaneously, combined with the signal characteristics of wide band and large dynamic range, and proposing a data acquisition system with high anti-interference and high resolution is needed. The system consists of filter and amplifier module, A/ D conversion module, storage module, digital signal processing and logic control module and GPS synchronous sampling module, with the current acquisition range from O.lA to 50A, the frequency range from O.lHz to 10kHz, and the current recording accuracy above 90%. After the test, CSAMT emission current record system based on the GPS Synchronous meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Retailer Order Forecast Based on Improved Exponential Smoothing Method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of the traditional exponential smoothing method in the prediction of retailer orders, an improved three - order exponential smoothing method is proposed. The optimal smoothing coefficient a is searched by the hybrid leapfrog algorithm. With the increase of the data, the a value also changes dynamically, which improves the efficiency of prediction and improves the accuracy of prediction. According to the number of retail sales data, dynamically change the size of the initial value of the smooth, reducing the value of the forecast on the smooth initial value of the degree of dependence. The experimental results show that the non - linear and non - regular characteristics of the retailer order quantity are obvious. The improved three - order exponential smoothing method can be used to forecast the retailer's order and the prediction accuracy is very high. The improved exponential smoothing method has a strong ability to adapt to the non-linear and non-regular nature of retailer orders.

articleTitle: Automatic Keyword Extraction Using Word Embedding and Clustering
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Existing word-frequency-based algorithms for keyword extraction do not consider the semantic relationships among words. Moreover, word-graph-based algorithms cannot distinguish multiple topics, and topic-model-based algorithms possess high time complexity. All of these keyword extraction algorithms exhibit limitations. This paper proposes a new word-embedding-based algorithm, namely, WEC, for keyword extraction. The algorithm incorporates word frequency, effects of word co-occurrence, and semantic relationship among contexts. The algorithm also estimates the final weights of words with cosine similarity and pointwise mutual information and extracts topics by clustering. Experimental results show that the WEC algorithm outperforms state-of-the-art keyword extraction methods on four datasets when tested under various evaluation metrics.

articleTitle: Optimal Control for AC and DC Power Quality of VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In Voltage Source Converter-based High Voltage DC transmission (VSC-HVDC), the unbalance of AC grid is caused by the power quality deterioration, such as AC grid current disturbance and DC voltage periodic ripple. Firstly, the forming reason of system power ripple is introduced under the unbalance of AC grid. An optimal control strategy for AC and DC is proposed. Taking the instantaneous active power without ripple, the voltage outer-loop based on sliding mode control is designed. Secondly, a grid current control under single d-q frame is proposed. With the VSC mathematical model of single d-q frame under the unbalance AC grid conditions, and the reference expressions of positive and negative sequence current components under single positive sequence d-q frame are obtained according the reverse-model principle. Furthermore, the proportional integral plus repetitive control strategy is proposed to implement the control of the current under the single d-q frame, as a result, the effect of the AC grid unbalance on the AC and DC power quality of VSC can be reduced. The corresponding simulation results verify the accuracy and feasibility of the proposed strategy.

Author Keywords: voltage source converter based high voltage DC transmission(VSC-HVDC)

articleTitle: A Defect Detection Technology Based on Software Behavior Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: With the increase of software system's size and complexity, a high requirement of the reliability, stability and security of software quality is put forward. At present, Machine learning technology is adopted in defect detection to realize code scanning and semantic analysis on software defects. The traditional machine learning technology for software defect detection is generally based on algorithms such as BP neural network model, naive Bayes model, and fingerprint identification model, etc. Regarding the features of software defect detection, this paper proposes a layered detection technology based on software behavior decision tree model. Furthermore, a corresponding test environment is established to make contrast test of previously tested software. The results of the experiment shows that, with the comprehensive consideration of building time cost and false alarm rate and other factors, the defect detection technology based on software behavior decision tree model is superior to other technologies.

articleTitle: Dental Hard Tissue Auto-registration Based on Modified ICP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Dental hard tissue registration is very challenging due to the complexity of histological structure, the variability of imaging modality and image quality. To benefit from the advantages of the relative works, a novel dental hard tissue auto-registration method based on the modified ICP algorithm was proposed, which was especially effective for intra-oral camera imaging. The dental images were firstly pre-processed to decrease the impact of imbalance local illumination. Secondly, a robust feature points extraction strategy was investigated and proposed, i.e. the boundary of hard tissue and lesion areas were calculated as feature point sets. Then the modified ICP algorithm was executed on the basis of the special designed point-pairs rejection method and the improved registration strategy. The experimental results show that the proposed method can converge more quickly and achipvp hiohr-r acclIracy.

articleTitle: Instantaneous Frequency Estimation for Motion Echo Signal of Projectile in Bore Based on Polynomial Chirplet Transform
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Microwave interferometer is one of the devices for measuring the movement travel- -varying or time-varying velocity of projectile in bore. Microwave interferometer first obtains the Doppler echo signal including the motion information of the projectile in bore, then the velocity is measured based on instantaneous frequency estimation (IFE) of the processed and transformed signal. The parametric time-frequency analysis method can make spectral energy of nonlinear frequency modulation (FM) signal concentrate at some range in the new transform domain. As the motion echo signal of projectile in bore (MSPB) is a nonlinear FM signal, it could be described by polynomial chirplet, one of polynomial FM signal modes, which is used to construct transform kernel for the signal. In this paper, Polynomial chirplet transform (PCT) method is proposed to analyze the simulation and experiment echo signals of projectile in bore. The estimation error and Renyi entropy are used to measure quantify of the time-frequency distribution. Compared with short-time Fourier transform (STFT) method and Wigner-Ville distribution (WVD) method, our results show that the PCT method has most powerful anti-interference performance and highest accuracy of instantaneous frequency estimation for the simulation signal, and lowest Renyi entropy of the instantaneous frequency estimation for the experiment signal. In general, the PCT method has powerful anti-interference performance and high time-frequency concentration and accuracy of instantaneous frequency estimation for the motion echo signal of projectile in bore.

articleTitle: Research on Motion Recognition Algorithm Based on Accelerometer
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In recent years, human motion recognition acceleration sensor has become one of the active research direction and the emerging field of computer pattern recognition, more and more researchers use acceleration sensor in motion monitoring of human experimental environment and natural living environment. Human motion recognition mainly includes data acquisition, data processing, feature extraction and selection, and classifier design. With the further development of microelectronics and sensors, sensors can be embedded in mobile devices, portable devices and so on. The use of acceleration sensor for human motion monitoring has broad application prospects. On the one hand, the daily exercise behavior is closely related to the physical and mental health. It is of great significance for the development of scientific exercise and fitness program to improve the health status. On the other hand, it is of great value to monitor the abnormal motion of human body. This kind of abnormal exercise can bring some harm to the human body. It can provide timely help to the fall and reduce the risk of falling. Through the comparison between threshold and peak vertical acceleration sensor data waveform threshold trough peak and valley time intervals of three characteristic values, and combined with the principle of decision tree classification to achieve accurate recognition of squatting, jumping and running action. A human fall detection algorithm, the algorithm falls by extracting human motion features in the process, focusing on the use of the three axis acceleration sensor correlation to fall over, fell back, left and right fall four to fall to distinguish fall behavior. The experimental results show that the average recognition rate of human motion behavior is more than 90%. which has a certain practical value.

articleTitle: Research on Rapid Extraction and Recognition Based on Depth Learning Method in Regional Nomination Mode
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The advent of the large data era, the development of deep learning theory helps to create a good condition. Data mining generally refers to the process of automatically searching for information that has special relevance hidden from a large amount of data. Data mining is usually related to computer science and it is achieved through statistical, on-line analytical processing, information retrieval, machine learning, expert systems which is relying on past rule of thumb and pattern recognition. This paper introduces the background of the deep learning development, and it mainly discusses the self-encoding method in the depth learning, and implements the simulation application from the self-coding method. The latest developments in information fusion technology make it possible to easily capture images of color and depth information in order to improve the image of object recognition. This paper also introduces a BP neural network model for feature learning and image classification. Our model achieves better artistic expression on standard image object sets, finally the results are more accurate and quicker in training and testing compared to other comparable architectures.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Humming Retrieval System Based on Melody
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Music retrieval technology based on humming is a new technology which has a wide application prospect in recent years. The goal of this paper is to construct a complete music retrieval system based on humming. Based on the research of humming music retrieval system, the paper focuses on two major aspects. The first aspect is the processing of humming audio and the extraction of melody features. The second aspect is melody matching algorithm. These two aspects are the core part of humming retrieval system, and also the focus of this paper. For the first aspect of the study, this paper first of the audio signal input from the microphone pretreatment, pretreatment process, including noise removal, pre emphasis and windowing. We adopt the method of setting the threshold value of the volume and the combination of the spectral subtraction, which can be realized by a high pass filter. We adopt the existing methods to implement the audio preprocessing process. As for melody feature extraction, we have done a lot of research work, carried out a large number of simulation experiments, and studied the existing Melody Extraction algorithms. At last, we choose the classical ACF auto correlation method to improve, and realize our own melody feature extraction process. At the same time, in order to build an available music feature library, we also studied the MIDI music melody extraction technology, combine the advantages of several commonly used algorithms, can extract a MIDI melody feature module, and generate the available library file.

articleTitle: Research on Classification Model of Emergency Communication Based on Rough Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The decision of emergency communication level is the basis and prerequisite for emergency communication guarantee in the emergency with different types and influential degrees. In this paper, a classification model of emergency communication guarantee is constructed by dominance rough set approach and BP neural network. Firstly, a classification index system of emergency communication is proposed. Secondly, the initial classification decision table is constructed with emergency communication guarantee cases. Through data pretreatment and attributes reduction, rules are generated with dominance rough set approach. Finally, the topology construction of BP neural network, the emergency communication classification model with fault tolerance and anti-interference ability, are constructed by the rules and training. Through model test of precision, the result proves that the model has good precision, and indicates that it is valid.

articleTitle: Error Quantification and Sensitivity Analysis to FTA Model for UHVDC Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Error and sensitivity models of the fault tree analysis (FTA) are newly investigated for reliability evaluation to the ultra high-voltage direct-current (UHVDC) systems. The fault trees are drawn based on the available capacities. It is found that the FTA of series systems falsely introduces outage modes involving more than one component, yielding availability lower than that using state space method; the error is related to the number and availability of the components. Absolute and relative sensitivities of state probabilities to reliability parameters are derived to show impact of parameter changes. It is found that the ratio of the absolute sensitivity to the repair and installation rates equals to the square of the ratio between the installation and the repair rates. The sum of all relative sensitivities to one component is zero, which helps to reduce calculation effort for sensitivity analysis. The DC lines have the most obviously impact on system reliability, followed by AC filters and DC smoothing reactors.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation of Distribution System Considering the Characteristics of Distributed Energy Fluctuation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of active distribution network, the integration of a large number of distributed energy sources brings new challenges to the power supply reliability analysis, while it is particularly important to evaluate the reliability of distribution network power supply. In this paper, a pseudo-sequential Monte Carlo simulation based approach is proposed to evaluate the reliability indices of distribution networks with renewable integrations. The proposed approach uses the non-sequential Monte Carlo sampling method for the initialization of the system states, and implements the sequential Monte Carlo simulation only on the fault process, which can obtain the reliability index of the distribution network quickly and accurately. It is especially applicable to the large-scale power network with distributed energy integration, i.e. the power system development trend in the future. In addition, the operation of microgrid, the consumption strategy of distributed energy and the optimal loading strategy are also considered in the proposed approach. Through tests on feeder 4 of IEEE RBTS-BUS6 system, the proposed approach is verified to be an appropriate method dealing with reliability analysis of active distribution networks the availability of this method and analyze the influence of distributed energy access on the reliability index of distribution network.

articleTitle: A Rehabilitation Robot Arm Based on Electromyographic
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: A sEMG analysis method based on neural network is proposed, which is applied to the control of rehabilitation robot arm. In this study, the sEMG acquisition system is designed to amplify and filter the original sEM G signal, the output signal are converted into digital signal by the NI acquisition card and sent to computer, and the data are analysed and patterned. Finally, the results are employed to control the rehabilitation robot arm. Experiments show that the proposed method can reduce the training time, overcome the lack of traditional EMG prosthetic control, and easily to be used. Rehabilitation patients can directly choose a variety of different limb movements with multi-degree of freedom of the arm control.

articleTitle: Fast Traffic Sign Recognition Based on Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Due to the uncontrollable conditions and poses of traffic signs, Traffic Sign Recognition (TSR) has been challenging the robustness and efficiency of the existing algorithm. In this work, a method of fast traffic sign recognition based convolutional neural networks (FTSR-CNN) is proposed. A new architecture of convolution neural network is designed, which extracts feature using convolution kernels by sliding filter, and reduces dimension by pooling. In forward propagation, the loss of the whole network is computed. Then stochastic gradient descent method is exploited to minimize loss in step of back propagation. The parameters and activation function of the network are adjusted to optimize the performance. Finally, the full connection is utilized to classify the traffic signs. Affine transformation increases diversity of training samples, which can enhance the adaptability. The proposed method has been evaluated on German Traffic Sign Recognition Benchmark and Tsinghua-Tencent 100K datasets. Experiments demonstrate that it is sufficient to attain high classification accuracy and ensure the efficiency.

articleTitle: A Simple Iterative Timing Recovery Algorithm for Burst Communication System at Very Low SNR
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The performance of low rate coding system could achieve close to Shannon limit, which has broad application prospects. While, the system brings higher requirement for the demodulator, especially for burst communication due to very low SNR(signal-to-noise ratio) condition. In this paper, we takes timing recovery, which is the first step in the demodulator, as a research content. Code-aided theory is an effective method for timing recovery at very low SNR. In order to overcome the contradiction between estimation range and implentation complexity for the existing code-aided algorithms, the trigonometric polynomial interpolation is introduced into M-search algorithm, and then accurate timing estimation could obtained with the use of the interpolation operation. Simulations indicate that compared with the existing algorithms, the proposed method has strong advantages both in terms of estimation performance and implementation complexity. Finally, a new receiver structure is provided here where frame synchronization and the proposed code-aided algorithm is combined implemented, with little performance loss, which could effectively solve the problem of initial synchronization for burst communication at very low SNR.

articleTitle: Decentralised PI Controller Design and Tuning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This paper compares two approaches to tune PI controllers in a multivariable process. A modified Direct Synthesis method extends the technique to a multivariable system. Results show that the modified Direct Synthesis technique relies on model accuracy and suitability of the desired transfer function and process model. The effectiveness of this technique may break down when these conditions are not met. Genetic algorithms provide a method based on the evolution of species via natural selection. The GA method allows the use of a specific structure, such as PI controller, and then gets the best possible results for that structure. The concept has been adapted into an optimisation technique that can be used to find the best controller parameters to meet user defined transient specifications for a complex process. Thus, the robustness of the method allows it to outperform the former technique. Simulation results are shown to illustrate the comparisons between these two methods and the effectiveness of GAs.

articleTitle: Modular Multi-level Converter Control Method Based on CPS - PWM
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The traditional voltage output of light DC transmission is mostly two-level or three-level. It is difficult to meet the high voltage and high power requirements of the power grid; MMC(Modular multi-level converter, MMC) becomes a hot spot in recent years because of modular structure, small harmonic content, easy to expand and so on. In this paper, according to the equivalent single-phase MMC topology and analyze the principle of MMC, using the voltage outer loop and current inner loop cooperate control strategy to control the capacitance of the sub-module and the system circulation by the carrier phase shift PWM modulation technique to modulate the power switch device. Finally verify the correctness of the control strategy by building the MMC model to simulation experiments through MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Optimization and Application of Indoor Localization Algorithm Based on ELMAN Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: It is a key problem in indoor localization accuracy that the received signal strength indicator (RSSI) is affected by changing environment such as diffraction, obstacles, and multi-path effect. To improve the accuracy, we propose an indoor localization algorithm based on ELMAN Neural Network. Firstly, we estimate the distance from point-to-point RSSI by using Kalman average filter. Then we reconstruct the RSSI according to the estimated distance. At last, we estimate the target coordinates by using ELMAN neural network. Experimental results show that our method can achieve the localization accuracy of 0.915 meter, and has good stability against RSSI variation in the localization.

articleTitle: Research of Moving Target Tracking Technology Based on LRCN
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Moving target tracking is a hot spot in computer vision in recent years. The tracking method, which is dominated by particle filter, has been widely used. The particle filter algorithm exhibits high complexity and poor real-time performance under large data processing conditions. With the development of neural networks and big data, a new LRCN network model combined with CNN and LSTM is proposed for moving target tracking in this paper. LRCN uses the deep learning framework to extract the characteristics of the video data. and uses the CNN to acquire the characteristics of the video sequence image, then make predictions in chronological order through the LSTM network structure. In addition, LRCN utilizes double deep learning to synchronize space convolution and time stream convolution. Using Matlab to experiment with standard data set VTB, remarkable results have been achieved in tracking accuracy and success rate with LRCN.

articleTitle: A Method for Rotor Rotation Speed Estimation Based on FMCW Radar
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, a rotor rotation speed estimation method is studied. Firstly, the radar rotor micro motion echo model of the wideband frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) is established; then, the echo matrix is transformed into a vector, and the rough estimation of the speed is estimated by coherent integration. Secondly, the real-valued inverse Radon transform (RIRT) algorithm is used to estimate the precise rotor rotation speed based on the theory of minimum image entropy. The proposed method improves the estimation accuracy by coherent and non-coherent integration respectively. The simulation results and the measured data verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Interpolation of Missing Data of Magnetic Flux Leakage in Oil Pipeline Based on Improved Supporting Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In the internal detection of submarine pipeline, the data exported from magnetic flux leakage detector may exist some missing data. In order to get accurate data, the magnetic flux leakage data should be preprocessed. The significant part of data preprocessing is to discriminate the missing data, and then to compensate these true values reasonably and effectively. In this paper, SVM algorithm is used in the process of single-channel interpolation to random missing data firstly. Secondly, the SVM traversal algorithm is proposed to achieve the interpolation of whole random missing data block. In order to improve the interpolation accuracy, an improved SVM algorithm is then introduced. The SVM traversal is carried out by using the axial data and the radial data respectively. Then based on the no missing values in the random missing data block, the least squares method is used to obtain the weight for interpolation of statistical missing data. Lastly, the real data exported from magnetic flux leakage detector is used to simulate. The interpolation results are compared with the BP neural network. The results show that this method is more feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Application of BP Neural Network in Image Compression Under the Matlab
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Artificial neural network plays the important role in more and more field, and the most basic network is BP (Back Propagation)neural network. Data was coded by BP neural network through multi-layer feedforward network to provide the ability of data compression. By data compression, image can be compressed, and it is called the application of artificial neural network in the image processing field. Using the artificial neural network to process image and through Matlab simulate experiment, the image can be compressed and reconstructed.

articleTitle: Intrusion Feature Selection Method Based on Neighborhood Distance
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Aiming at problem that independent and redundant attributes of intrusion data cause intrusion detection algorithms' slow detection speed and low detection rate in intrusion detection. An intrusion feature selection method based on neighborhood distance is proposed. The approach clustered again on the selected feature subset. The use of the selected feature subset can improve clustering accuracy and speed. Simulation experiment is done in KDD99. Result shows that compared with Genetic algorithm and Relief algorithm, the approach is more effective for feature selection of intrusion data and improvement of intrusion detection speed of classification algorithms.

articleTitle: A Wideband Double-Layer E-shaped Microstrip Antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The multiple advantages has made microstrip antenna suitable for numerous applications. However, the narrow bandwidth impedes the further development of microstrip antenna. The limitation of microstrip antenna bandwidth ranges from 3% to 8% in normal conditions. In this paper, a wideband double-layer E-shaped microstrip antenna with high gain is proposed. The central working frequency is about 2.27 GHz. Results indicate that the relative bandwidth can achieve 21.15% with the VSWR < 2. The gain is higher than 8.26dB when ranging from 2.03 GHz to 2.51 GHz.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Nonlinear Dynamic Characteristics of Gear Drive System in Shearer Cutting
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, the nonlinear dynamic model of the shearer's gear transmission system is established by taking the gear transmission system of the shearer's cutting part as the research object. Considering the damping ratio, the meshing stiffness and the excitation frequency on the nonlinear dynamic The results show that: the smaller the damping ratio, the greater the nonlinear effect of the second-order planetary gear system on the sun wheel displacement response; the greater the meshing stiffness will cause the sun wheel displacement response to exhibit chaos; when the excitation frequency changes, the sun wheel of response is transformed from periodic to chaotic response and then back to quasi-periodic response. This kind of research method provides the theoretical support for the related nonlinear problem, and provides a reasonable analysis basis for design.

articleTitle: Design of Underwater High-Precision Ultrasonic Phased Array Transmitting System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In order to meet the requirement of underwater ultrasonic phased array imaging system, a high-precision underwater ultrasonic phased array transmitting system is designed and implemented. The system adopts FPGA as the control core, and realizes the high precision phase controlled delay of 0.5ns. At the same time, a driving circuit is built with a high speed triode to realize phase control emission, level conversion and power amplification of the 16 way ultrasonic trigger signal. The system can achieve high-precision focusing emission and deflection emission by setting various phase controlled delay. The actual test results show that the system realizes triggering of ultrasonic phased array transducer, and the phase delay accuracy and low hardware complexity, driving ability, stable and reliable, can provide a good foundation for improving the imaging quality of phased array system.

articleTitle: Research on Big Data Storage Structure and Query Optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Big data not only requires massive storage systems, but also requires high speed data loading, fast query processing, high utilization of storage space, and adaptive dynamic high load. Because the traditional relational database has encountered various difficulties and obstacles in managing big data, a new distributed system has emerged. But in large data storage and query there are still shortcomings, this article from two aspects of data storage structure and correlation graphs homework for distributed system of data storage structure and query optimization analysis. In this paper, from the input correlation, correlation data transformation, three aspects of job stream correlation is optimized to improve the result of the translation, and gives optimization conditions and optimization rules, merging redundant graphs assignments in order to reduce unnecessary resource consumption, thus improve the big data query speed.

articleTitle: Survey of Signal Parameter Identification Technology
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In today's complex battlefield environment, the interference signal parameter identification is the key to distinguish the interference signals, and the basis of winning information warfare. This paper first introduces the five traditional characteristic parameters that must be extracted in the signal sorting, and introduces the extraction methods and steps of the five parameters in detail. Then, from the point of distinguishing the parameter invariant signals and the parameter agile signals, presents two common signal sorting algorithms. Finally, the content of this paper is summarized.

articleTitle: Cross Regional Cluster of Message-Oriented Middleware
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: As compared to centralized servers, cross-regional clustering message have advantages in terms of low cost, high fault tolerance, easy expansion and load balance so that clustering message severs become one of the major directions to solve the middleware server performance problems and improve cross-regional service capabilities. Based on the deep analysis of the working principle and operation mechanism of message-oriented middleware, this article proposes a cross-regional clustering technology of message-oriented middleware, which focuses on solving the technical difficulties of nodes synchronization, multi-active service and load balance in cross-regional cluster. Experiments show that the solution works well.

articleTitle: Study on Insulation Fault of Cable Joint in an Electric Field Diagnosis Technique
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the electric field detection technology of distribution cable joints. In this paper, the theory of electric field distribution of cable joint applied to distribution network environment is studied by simulation technology, which provides technical support for accurate evaluation of insulation fault of cable joint in distribution network.

articleTitle: High Confidence Staple for Visual Tracking
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In the visual tracking, correlation filtering (CF) based on tracking algorithms have shown favorable performance in recent years, and have the impressive performance on benchmark datasets. However, the tracking model has limited information about their context and can easily drift in cases of fast motion, occlusion or background clutter, and the trackers update tracking models at each frame without considering whether the detection is accurate or not. In this paper, we present an improved strategy that is adding more background context and changing the tracker model updating strategy. Experimental results show that the performance of the model has been improved effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Anti-Backlash Control Strategy of Asymmetric Dual-Motor Driving System Based on a Small Power Auxiliary Motor
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In order to improve the stability accuracy of the weapons control system in infantry fighting vehicle and combined with the actual modified situation of the gun control system, a modification method of the asymmetrical double motor driving system based on a small power auxiliary motor is proposed. In this paper, the feasibility of the asymmetric dual-motor driving system is proved by a detailed analysis of the double motor clearance process. Then, based on the working mode of symmetrical double motor system, the control strategy of asymmetric double motor system is designed. Finally, through the simulation of the asymmetric double motor system in the interference environment, we proved that asymmetrical double motor drive system can improve the stability accuracy of the gun control system effectively.

articleTitle: Online Health Monitoring of the Electrolytic Capacitor in DC-DC Converters
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Electrolytic capacitor is widely used in DC-DC converter as filter capacitor, but it has higher failure rate than other components in DC-DC converter. In order to monitor the health of the electrolytic capacitor, the equivalent series resistance (ESR) is selected as monitoring target. This paper propose a novel method to monitor the rising equivalent series resistance to predict the failure of electrolytic capacitor. The proposed method has the advantage at low cost and high ratability that can easily integrated in DC-DC converter. The simulation results are given to verify the merits of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Micro Application of Electric Power Communication Network Index Management Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Based on the requirement of the Reduce of electric power communication network failures, the micro application of index management based on big data technology is designed and implemented. The micro application includes three application modules: equipment monitoring module, index analysis module and decision-making management module. The methodology which consist of the population mean value, the regional mean value and the equipment average value provides the theoretical basis of the index management of the electric power communication network. Through the comprehensive analysis of communication equipment data, communication link data, communication operation and maintenance data and external multivariate data, the micro application of index management based on big data technology realized a comprehensive perception of the electric power communication network and realized timely processing of risk, so the intelligent assistant user decision is realized.

articleTitle: Research on Model of Road Traffic Data Bbased on Large Data of Video
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Because of the traffic management of the video monitoring system has the characteristics of fast, networked, high-definition and intelligent development, In view of the low utilization rate and disorder of the current traffic information data collection, facing the impact of the “flood” resulting data, this paper presents a traffic video big data analysis and mining depth model definition video description file, this paper presents an algorithm for mining reasonable traffic data based on the value of video analysis, video structured data on the early formation of a unified encoding, and the target area by the number of intersections of mining, mining the data can be automatically selected for the trunk road green wave control, surveillance video the value of data into information file contains content of semantic information, so as to improve the use efficiency of traffic monitoring system.

articleTitle: Multi-target Tracking Based on Improved Particle Filter Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: For realizing the multi-target tracking in unknown clutter environment, focus on the insufficiencies of the BPF framework, an algorithm is proposed which combined the HOG&Adaboost detection with the mixture particle filter(MPF), the fusion of the Sub-Integral Histogram and the LBP feature is constructed as a dynamic observation model for every target. Finally, the proposed algorithm is not only to realize the multi-target tracking, but also is robust to solve the problem of the appearance and disappearance of targets in the video sequences. Besides, it also can handle the short-time partial occlusion, similar appearance and the cross movement efficiently.

articleTitle: Hybrid Domain Audio Watermarking Embedding Algorithm Based on Redundant Discrete Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In order to protect the digital rights of Internet digital media, an audio digital watermarking algorithm based on redundant discrete wavelet transform (RDWT), discrete cosine transform (DCT) and QR decomposition is proposed. The second-order redundant wavelet transform is carried out after the segmented original audio, the discrete cosine transform is carried out on the obtained approximate component, and the QR is decomposed into the low-frequency part to embed the watermark information. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has strong robustness and imperceptibility for common vicious attacks such as MP3 compression, resampling, low pass filtering, re-quantization and Gaussian agitation.

articleTitle: Wireless Coverage in Undulating Terrain Based on Ray Tracing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In order to explore the wireless coverage in undulating terrain, the theoretical basis of ray tracing is introduced, including geometrical optics and uniform theory of diffraction. Based on this, the wireless channel parameters and their corresponding formulas are provided. In addition, the environment modeling method in view of complex typical indoor scenes is put forward, and a new standard environment information format which can be used in indoor 3D ray tracing algorithm is designed. What's more, the operation steps of 3D indoor ray tracing coverage prediction are described in detail, and the accurate prediction of narrowband and broadband results in the indoor femtocell environment is realized. And several experiments are done to verify the algorithms in different scenes. The experimental results showed that on the condition of no sacrificing prediction accuracy, the prediction efficiency of ray tracing model is improved. As a result, it is concluded that the ray tracing has certain accuracy in predicting wireless coverage.

articleTitle: Research on Image Algorithm Based on Contrast
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This paper adopts the algorithm to analyze the contrast ratio from the global and local level, providing improvements in enhancing image contrast concerning the global, as well as the local features. While extracting prominent features of images, the algorithm GC and RC are adopted during this process, delivering weighted algorithm to space information. Besides, the local contrast algorithm adopts spatial weighting optimization to strengthen the differences between the target region and its surroundings. From the experimental results in saliency maps, the proposed algorithm succeeds to completely extract the target in high-contrast region.

articleTitle: Authentic Data Space: A Security Data Co-Existence Schema Based on Tagging Technique
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, the Authentic Data Space (ADS)model for uniting data, security and business is proposed for many serious problems in the field of data management, data security and variable business supported by data. We illustrate the method to build ADS from three dimensions of data dimension, business dimension and security dimension, then we provide the reference system framework of ADS based on them. This provides effective technical methods for solving the problems of data management, data security and business requirements in the big data situation.

articleTitle: Research on Grounding Mode of Ship Medium Voltage AC/DC Hybrid Power System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The medium voltage power system of ship is mainly based on AC/DC hybrid power. In order to prevent the obvious influence on the ship power system from AC side fault, the appropriate grounding mode should be select for the system. Based on ship medium voltage AC/DC hybrid power system with parallel 12 pulse rectifier, through the method of simplifying the circuit of system to ground, the influence of synchronous rectifier generator neutral grounding mode on DC single pole common mode voltage, non-fault phase voltage and fault current is analyzed, the influence of DC side capacitance midpoint grounding mode on the DC overvoltage is analyzed, for the single-phase ground fault of synchronous rectifier generator on AC side. The selection basis of grounding mode of the neutral point of synchronous rectifier generator and the neutral point of capacitance on DC side is carried out, and the correctness of the conclusion is verified by PSCAD/EMTDC simulation.

articleTitle: Vehicle Tracking Based Traffic State Estimation Method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: To reveal the real and hidden information of urban traffic system, this paper proposed a vehicle-tracking based traffic state estimation method. First, some terms are introduced to facilitate the following algorithm. Then, the A* heuristic search algorithm is calibrated to give the optimal path between two neighboring GPS points. Next, a vehicle-tracking based algorithm is proposed to calculate the spatiotemporal average velocity and estimate the traffic states. Finally, a real probe car dataset in Beijing is used to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed method. In the validation experiments, the ground truth was determined by manually recording the passing time of the same vehicle and the experiment results proves the effectiveness of the proposed method to estimate the traffic states in large-scale urban road network.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Improving the Efficiency of Storing and Accessing Medical Image Files on Hadoop
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, HDFS is used to solve the storage problem of mass medical image data. However, HDFS does not consider the correlation between medical small files. As an open source distributed file system, HDFS has reliability, scalability, low cost of storage capacity and many other advantages. But it has poor performance on the directly processing of small medical image files. In this paper, multi-strategy merge model-HMERGE is presented to solve the problems of size differences and number difference between the common medical image types, like CT, CR and US. On this basis, we design prefetching and caching mechanism based on the correlation between small files to improve storage and access efficiency. Experiments show that the presented scheme can effectively reduce the load of NameNode in HDFS and improve the efficiency of storing and accessing small medical image files.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Detection Fusion Influential Factors of Point Sources
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: There are lots of factors existing to influence the distributed detection fusion algorithms of point sources. The writer has taken advantage of the numerical simulation experiments and studied the final fusion results under elements of prior probability, cost functions, parameters of source terms, false dismissal and false alarm rate of individual toxic agent alarm. It turns out that detection fusion algorithms have a great adaptability that owns an upgraded detection accuracy with influential elements changing all the time.

articleTitle: Advances in Simulation Study on the Dynamic Characteristics of Projectile Penetrating Target
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The penetration is a high-speed dynamic nonlinear mechanical problem. There are lots of influencing factors, and the process of penetration is complicated. It is difficult to correctly describe the whole process with traditional single method. In this paper, the simulation of the penetration in recent years was briefly summarized, which provided a reference for the simulation of the dynamic characteristics of the projectile penetrating pine target.

articleTitle: Exploiting Optimization Mechanism for Pick-up Points Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: With the ubiquity of smartphone devices., taxi dispatching applications have been prevailing in recent years, enabling us to travel effortlessly as per our needs. In this paper, we study the problem of taxi dispatching optimization. Specifically, we develop a novel clustering based scheme that can exploit multi-source information, such as trajectory-based features and road features, for taxi pick-up points recommendations. Our scheme is based on two observations. First, taxi's pick-up points can be influenced by their spatiotemporal clustering. Second, human mobility patterns can reflect the popularity of waiting areas to a certain degree. We carry out our method on historical trajectories generated by over 23,000 taxis during one year. The experimental results validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of UPFC Sub-Synchronous Oscillation Controller
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Sub-synchronous oscillation (SSO) is a specific dynamic behavior due to the coupling of mechanic and electrical parts of power system, which is a severe stability problem. Unified Power Flow Controller (UPFC), as the most advanced FACTS device, can restrain the system oscillation effectively through proper design. In this paper, UPFC's ability to damp SSO was studied first. Then a supplementary sub-synchronous oscillation controller of unified power flow controller based on modal control was proposed. Damping analysis and simulation indicates that this designed UPFC damping controller is capable of SSO mitigation, which can guarantee a safe and stable operation of the system.

articleTitle: Application of Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm in Computer Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Particle swarm optimization algorithm is a new intelligent optimization algorithm, which is based on the social activities of biological groups.
