Because the particle swarm optimization algorithm is random and uncertain, the theoretical basis of the algorithm is still not complete, for example, there are some problems, such as the premature convergence, slow convergence speed and so on. Particle swarm optimization algorithm theory analysis and improvement has become the focus and hotspot of the algorithm. Therefore, based on the theory of the traditional PSO algorithm analysis based on, combined with algorithm for biological prototype features, improved PSO algorithm is proposed for the convergence of the algorithm. Because the traditional BP artificial neural network learning algorithm is an optimization algorithm based on gradient information, algorithm is easy to fall into local optimum defects. Therefore, in this paper, the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used in neural network training. This study not only can improve the theoretical basis of the PSO algorithm, but also provide a reference for the application of PSO algorithm in artificial neural network.

articleTitle: Optimization of Multiple Laser Range Finder Distribution Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This paper deals with the optimization of multiple laser ranger finder distribution used for Shipborne Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) automatic landing. The aim of this study is to improve the measurement accuracy of shipborne multiple laser ranger finder intersection location method. Firstly, the exact mathematical relationship between the distribution and measurement accuracy of multiple laser ranger finder is discussed, and the objective function of optimization is constructed. Then the geometry of the ship deck which will constrain the distribution is considered. Genetic algorithm is used to solve the optimization problem. At last, the simulation experiments based on MATLAB are presented and the experiment results indicate that optimal distribution is effective in reducing measurement error of shipborne multiple laser ranger finder intersection location method.

articleTitle: Centrifugal-Force Micro Motion Platform Using Vibration Motor
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Vibration motor has the centrifugal effect of eccentric mass. when installed on the motion platform, it will produce displacement under a certain conditions. This paper presents a micro motion platform by using two vibration motors to drive synergistically based on the centrifugal effect of eccentric mass. In order to achieve the motion of forward, backwards and rotation, a driver module of electric motor is used to adjust the turning and revolving speed of motors. Platform's movement is driven directly by vibration which can simplify the transmission mechanism and contribute to miniaturization. The feasibility of realizing the desired motion function is proved by simulations based on ADAMS model and experiments.

articleTitle: A Method for Data Synchronization Based on JMS and XML
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of data synchronization between different distributed network environments, a method of data synchronization based on java message service and xml technology is presented and the major technology and work process is introduced in detail. Experimental results show that the proposed method is real time efficient and reliable, it can be extend to multilevel distribution database system.

articleTitle: Power Budget of Earth to Moon Deep Space Communication System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The characteristics of deep space laser transmission are analyzed. Considering the engineering factors such as optical system, channel and link distance, the link equation of deep space optical communication is deduced. The optical system and the atmospheric channel loss are estimated to be about 12.85dB. The earth to moon link distance is about 38,000 kilometers, adopting pulse position modulation system, the budget of uplink average receiving power is 4.14× 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>μW, the average transmit power is 28.98mW. The downlink average receiving power is 6.21× 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>μW, and the average transmit power is 434.7mW. The analysis results will be of much importance to the design of the earth to moon optical communication system.

articleTitle: A Novel Over-Exposed Region Detection Algorithm Using Non-Linear Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, a new algorithm to detect overexposed regions in images is presented. The algorithm uses non-linear support vector machines (nSVM) and characteristics of over-exposed image features to detect the over-exposed regions. These features include intensity and color, as well as novel features of intensity-chrominance and boundary neighborhood. Optimal parameters for the classifier are obtained by using training sets for different scenes. The experimental results show that the detected over-exposed regions are better in terms of more connectivity and integrity. In addition, it has less isolated over-exposed pixels compared to previous method that is based on solely intensity and color features, which are more susceptible to noise.

articleTitle: Research and Software Implementation of Phase Coded Signal Processing in Tracking and Instrumentation Radar
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In order to solve the phase-coded signal Doppler sensitive problem, the Doppler search algorithm based on frequency domain is often used. However, in tracking and measuring radar, the traditional algorithm is difficult to meet the requirements due to the requirement of target measurement accuracy and real-time signal processing. This paper focuses on the 13 bit Barker code signal, based on the analysis of the characteristics of the Barker code signal, completes the high precision Doppler compensation of the single pulse signal under the CPU+GPU software platform using a Doppler compensation algorithm based on time-domain. At the same time, combined with classical tracking radar algorithm, effectively improve the real-time signal processing. Completed the phase code on the target of precision measurement and tracking.

articleTitle: Intelligent Manufacturing Product's Defect Recognition Based on Convolutional Neural Network, and its Feedback Algorithm's Learning Rate Optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Intelligent manufacturing is a kind of system composed of intelligent machine and human experts. In order to recognize the defects of products in intelligent manufacturing process, a new recognition method based on convolutional neural network algorithm is proposed. Using the method of transfer learning, the training neural network is realized by the Inception-v3 model in the deep learning framework TensorFlow. Based on the implementation of training network, this paper optimizes the learning rate of network feedback algorithm and improves the pass rate and system stability. At present, the method has been applied to the field of rubber pipe manufacturing, and the experimental results show that the method can recognize the defect of multiple rubber pipes without the complex pretreatment of the image. And it can recognize many kinds of defects of rubber pipes, with high precision and small complexity, which have strong robustness and adaptability.

articleTitle: The Influence of a Particular Error Pattern on the Error Correction Performance of RS+Convolutional Concatenated Code
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Our paper introduces a typical concatenated code, analyzes its performance about the error correcting capability and possible vulnerability. Moreover, an error pattern is proposed based on its coding structure. We also made a simulation to compare the influence to the decoding performance of concatenated code between the proposed error pattern and the traditional random error patterns. The simulation results show that the effect degree of erroneous pattern proposed on the concatenated code is higher than that of the random error pattern.

articleTitle: Inner Composition Alignment Analysis of Brain Function Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Study of complex networks has gradually penetrated into various fields of the social sciences, and it has become an important tool for people to solve problems. Brain network research has become a hot topic in today's brain function networks research. This paper contributes to construct brain network, from a new perspective, based on electroencephalogram (EEG) by one-way algorithm of inner composition alignment. Then the network's statistical characteristics the average node degree and clustering coefficient are analyzed, the results fulfill the small world characteristics of complex network. Compared with normal brain network, it is found that the IOTA coefficient of the epileptic brain network, the average node degree and the clustering coefficient are significantly different from normal. Thus these results verify the validity of the IOTA algorithm to analyze brain network, as well as the dynamics of epilepsy research and provides important reference basis for clinical diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on Windowing Technology of NC-OFDM System Based on Cognitive Radio
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: NC-OFDM is the main transmission mode of cognitive radio system. The windowing technique can speed up the attenuation of NC-OFDM out-of-band power spectrum and reduce the out-of-band interference of NC-OFDM symbols. Based on the distribution of subcarriers in NC-OFDM system, this paper firstly proposed the power interference model of the perceive users to authorized users. And the average relative interference power density is proposed as P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">R→L</sub> for the model. The interference power of the different window function is applied to the NC-OFDM system with the average relative interference power density as P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">R→L</sub> interference with the smallest power SOCW window, combined with the receiver's BER performance and out-of-band power attenuation rate to select the SOCW parameters.

articleTitle: Reliability Growth Test Approach for Braking System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Based on the Reliability Test Profile, this research focuses on simulating the service operating stress by test stress, and successfully completes the Reliability Growth Test for a certain aircraft braking system, as well as the service life and MTBF assessment. Using the Reliability Simulation Test, the paper makes some improvement to the design defects of the braking system items.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on the Unbalanced Operation Characteristics of a Three-Phase Auto-Transformer with Asymmetrical Winding Parameters
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, a simulation technique is presented to study the unbalanced operation characteristics of a three-phase auto-transformer with asymmetrical winding parameters. First, the parameters such as winding resistances, impedance and capacitance were derived from the experimental results. Then, an equivalent model was set up based on MATLAB/Simulink. Finally, the unbalanced operation characteristics were then presented and discussed with the asymmetrical impedance and capacitance. The simulation results indicated that three-phase autotransformers can operate with slight asymmetrical parameters.

articleTitle: Classification of Sci-Tech Innovative Talents Based on Bayesian Classifier
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The fundamental solution to the major problems in the developing country and one of the significant aspect of building an innovative country are all based on the sci-tech innovation, which is defined as the activity of creation and innovation in the sci-tech field, but the lack of sci-tech innovative talents is regarded as the most obvious problem in sci-tech innovative activity. For the purpose of solving the problem of the identifying and cultivating talents of sci-tech innovation, this paper begins with the concept processing of the individual understanding of the world, and it is specifically divided into the following steps: the key factors influencing the talents of sci-tech innovation is analyzed systematically, the set of evaluation indicators of sci-tech talents are constructed, and then the sci-tech innovative talents classification model is built by using the Bayesian classifier and the collected data samples are simulated to verify the rationality of the model available. As the results indicated that the difference of different types of sci-tech talents can be effectively distinguished by the classification model of sci-tech innovative talents based on Bayesian classifier, and the important theoretical and practical significances are provided for the identification and promotion of sci-tech innovative talents.

articleTitle: Application of MATLAB Software in Reliability Verification Test of Success or Failure Product
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In the reliability test, fixed number testing scheme is used for the test, the scheme can be made according to the national standard GB/T 5080.5-1985 by look-up table, but the table provides limited data, sometimes need interpolation. This paper presents a fast establishment method for fixed number testing program of reliability verification test, the method can rapidly set up a fixed number testing scheme according to the given product reliability, the identification ratio and the risk value of both the producer and the user.

articleTitle: Study on Wifi Indoor Location Techniques Based on Android
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This article focuses on the study and improvement of fingerprint location algorithm and designs, and implements the wireless-free internet indoor location system based on an Android platform. We have attempted to improve the accuracy of indoor location results. Our approach consisted of two main algorithms: A sampling algorithm uses a received signal strength indicator vector to construct the location fingerprint database. We tested 20 times at each sample point and stored the average result in the location fingerprint database to avoid errors introduced by signal fluctuations. A matching algorithm analyzes the location of the test point based on a K-nearest neighbor (K-NN) algorithm. Here, we introduced penalty to improve the accuracy of the K-NN algorithm. We evaluated the system in a busy engineering building and demonstrated localization accuracies in a 5m x 5m area. The results show that our system is capable of completely controlling the error in distances under 1.5m, and is promising in contrast with the results of previous studies.

articleTitle: The Application of Exhaustive Service Polling Control Theory in the Intelligent Traffic System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Social progress brought about the development of the city, more and more people choose to go out by car, the continuous increase in vehicles to the city's traffic has brought great inconvenience, the traditional traffic lights can not meet the needs of urban development and ease traffic pressure. This paper presents an intelligent transportation system based on FPGA for exhaustive service polling control theory, based on the knowledge of polling theory, and then obtains the arrival rate of vehicles. From the various data, the arrival rate is proportional to the waiting time. The simulation results show that the intelligent traffic system under the condition of full service polling control can alleviate the traffic jam and improve the traffic efficiency.

articleTitle: Reconstruction Method of Overlapped Citrus Fruits in Natural Scenes Based on Convex Hull
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: A reconstruction method based on convex hull was developed to reconstruct the overlapped citrus in natural scenes in order to improve the success rate of citrus harvesting robot. Due to the circular shape of citrus fruit, two reconstruction parameters were determined: the center point and the radius. Firstly, the K-means clustering method and threshold segmentation method were applied to detect the citrus targets in HSV color space. After that, the center points of each citrus fruit targets were extracted respectively by combing with the convex hull and the minimum external affine transformation rectangle. Finally, the reconstruction radiuses of the overlapped citrus targets were determined by searching the gray scale gradient extremum along the connecting line of each center point of citrus and the occlusion order is given. Experiments verified the validity of the method proposed. It provides a basis for the design of end-effector and the path planning of the harvesting robot.

articleTitle: Improved Multiple Model Particle Filter for Maneuvering Target Tracking in the Presence of Delayed Measurements
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, a particle filter is designed to deal with a class of nonlinear systems where the measurements undergo multi-step random delay due to the limited transmission capability of data link. First, a discrete-time variable governed by a Markov chain is defined to describe the measurement random delay. Considering the target maneuver, the multi-model method is adopted where another discrete-time variable is introduced to model the system as a jump Markov system. Second, the two newly defined variables are used to augment the original state vector, and then a hybrid system containing two kinds of discrete-time components is obtained. Finally, the hybrid system is estimated in the particle filtering framework and the simulation results show the proposed filter can effectively deal with the systems where the target maneuver and measurement delay occur simultaneously.

articleTitle: Analysis of Atomic Clock Offset Anomalies Effect on Frequency Stability Estimation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The calculation of atomic clock frequency stability will have a large deviation in estimation of Allan variance due to clock offset anomalies. In this paper, various models of clock offset anomalies are established, and the effects of three kinds of clock offset anomalies such as phase outlier, phase jump, and frequency jump on the atomic clock frequency stability estimation are derived theoretically, followed by experimental verification. The experiment results show that phase outlier is equivalent to the effect of white phase modulation noise, which will lead to deviation in short-term frequency stability estimation; and phase jump is equivalent to the effect of the white frequency modulation noise, which will lead to deviation in both short-term and long-term frequency stability estimation; and frequency jump is equivalent to the sum of random walk frequency modulation noise and white frequency modulation noise, which will lead to deviation in long-term frequency stability estimation. The model established in this paper can provide basis for clock offset anomalies simulation and robust estimation of atomic clock frequency stability.

articleTitle: Intelligent Hybrid Modeling for PMSM in Static Three-Phase Frame in View of Reluctance Torque
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Intelligent Hybrid model of permanent magnetic synchronous motor (PMSM) in static three-phase frame is proposed in this paper by analyzing the magnetic flux linkage, and transforming the two-phase rotor frame to the static three-phase frame, the voltage balance equation becomes a nonlinear, time-variant dynamic system if the leakage inductance and the difference between the equivalent inductance in d axis and q axis are all considered. Then the stator voltage model is established as a switched function, for the voltage is produced by the bridge inverter. Combines the above together, a kind of hybrid model system in static three-phase frame is achieved. And it is validated by the simulation, where the computation is carried out by approximate discretization of the hybrid model.

articleTitle: Development of Near-infrared Spectroscopy Signal Collecting System Based on Digital Demodulation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Achieving demodulation for near-infrared spectroscopy signal with digital envelope demodulation technique. A near-infrared spectroscopy signal collecting system with simple and flexible signal processing are designed and implemented. Altera Corporation's CPLD EPM240TIOOC5N, which has enough I/O ports for the system expansion, was selected to generate sequence pulse for ADS8505; STC89LE54RD+ was used used as microcontroller. Quartus II development environment was used to design internal procedure of CPLD. Experiments on effect of total sampling periodical number on SNR (single-to-noise ratio) and effect of single periodical sampling number on SNR were designed to implement system detection and verification. Compared with the phase-sensitive detection circuit, the digital signal processing is simple and flexible, and simplifies circuit and reduces the debugging steps.

articleTitle: Urban Rail Transit Automatic Train Operation System Online Algorithm Research
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Automatic Train Operation(ATO) used in current urban rail systems combines with two levers of control. The upper level of control is a recommended curve optimized offline with some operation performance indicators. The lower level of control tracks the recommended curve with specified strategies. While the running environment changes, the operation performance indicators can not be satisfied any more. Moreover, for multi-level of operation, multi recommended curves generated off line consume a large storage of the ATO systems. Even, time delay will be caused by these pre-setting curves in some situations. This paper proposed an online ATO algorithm based on neural network predictive control with energy optimization, which is adapting to the variety of running environment. The neural networks are used as the predictive model of the nonlinear system. Two types of neural networks, Error Back Propagation (BP) Neural Network and Radial Basis Function (RBF) Neural Network, are studied and compared in this paper. As the energy-saving is considered in the performance indicators, as well as the accurate parking and punctuality, the Modified Particle Swarm Optimization(MPSO) is used as the rolling optimization algorithm to reduce the computation. Simulation carried with field data shows a good performance and practicality of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Trust Evaluation Model for the Panorama Dynamic Based on on Expanding Subjective Logic
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, the advantages and disadvantages of subjective logic proposed by Josang are analyzed, and a trust evaluation model for the panorama dynamic based on extending subjective logic is proposed. The model is used to expand the subjective fuzzy logic theory, and the image matching and image fusion algorithms are used to improve the speed and quality of the panorama and enhance the sensitivity of the system. All these above mentioned pave the way for exploring the development of the future fuzzy mathematics theory in the virtual reality.

articleTitle: A Group Decision Making Method Based on Mixed Multi-Attribute and VIKOR
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of group decision making with multiple attributes and mixed evaluation information, an evaluation method based on intuitionistic fuzzy and VIOKR is proposed. Firstly, the different types of attribute values are transformed into intuitionistic fuzzy numbers so that deal with the mixed evaluation information, which reduces the randomness and fuzziness of the evaluation. Then, the minimum deviation optimization model is established and the weight of the expert is calculated, which solves the problem that the weight information of experts and attributes is unknown. Then VIKOR theory is introduced to aggregate the information and evaluate, next compared with the TOPSIS method to illustrate the feasibility and reliability of this algorithm. Finally, a power supply vehicle is viewed as the research object to make decision on the level of personnel business, the results show that the group decision-making method can realize the decision-making effectively, and has better application value in engineering.

articleTitle: Research on the Hydrodynamic Characteristic of Conformal Semi-Ring Wing Configuration
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: To meet the demand for flying both in air and water, a conformal semi-ring wing configuration is proposed in the design of air-water crossing vehicle. Aiming at the demand of high-velocity hydrodynamic characteristics, a multiphase flow model is introduced to the numerical simulations. The pressure distribution of the air-water crossing vehicle at different velocities and attack angles is studied and the shape and location of the cavitation are obtained. The results provide support for the subsequent optimization and experimental verification of air-water crossing vehicle.

articleTitle: Application of Loadrunner Automated Test Tool in Cloud Platform Performance Test
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Cloud computing describes a new Internet which is based on IT service value-added, and it is also a use and delivery model which is a combination of data sharing and service sharing computing model. With the popularization of cloud computing, how high-speed, low-cost storage and management of large amounts of data generated in the cloud has become the focus of major enterprises and organizations. The rapid development and popularization of the Internet for the network streaming media business development is providing a strong market power, network streaming media technology has also been widely used, and the user demanding for streaming media business is also growing. This article first briefly describes what Loadrunner is and its working principle of cloud platform, and then it describes how to use Loadrunner cloud platform performance stress test, research and analysis of test results, put forward the corresponding solution.

articleTitle: Incremental Processing of Continuous K Nearest Neighbor Queries Over Moving Objects
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: For a given set of moving objects and a k nearest neighbor query q, the processing of Continuous K Nearest Neighbor (CKNN) query refers to search the k nearest objects for q and continuously monitor its result in real-time with the objects and the query point moving. Most existing works about processing CKNN queries usually exist some flaws about the index maintenance, real-time updates of results, and the query cost, which makes them hardly can perfectly settle this issue. To address this challenge, we propose an incremental search algorithm to handle CKNN queries over a tremendous volume of moving objects with a Random Estimate method. In particularly, our approach adopts the grid index to maintain the moving objects in real-time. For a given query q, IS-CKNN first employs YPK-CNN algorithm to compute the initial result of q. Next, it designs the Random Estimation (RE) method, to rapidly estimate an appropriate search region that guarantees covering k nearest neighbors of q based on its previous search scope. This strategy can immediately compute the appropriate search space for the moving query without iteratively enlarging the search region, which can greatly enhance the search efficiency. Finally, we conduct extensive experiments to fully evaluate the performance of our proposal.

articleTitle: A Design of MAC Layer DCF Protocol for IEEE 802.11 Network Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: How to make communication more efficient and reduce energy consumption in wireless network is an important issue to be considered in the design of MAC protocol. When a large number of nodes share a wireless channel for data transmission, and the user is intermittent work, the need to use the MAC protocol in the random multiple access technology (DCF). In this paper, a design of MAC protocol based on FPGA is proposed, which uses the hardware circuit description language HDL Verilog and the circuit principle diagram input method to design the simulation.

Author Keywords: the method of circuit principle diagram input

articleTitle: Research on Prediction Method of Terrorist Attack Based on Random Subspace
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In the process of risk prediction of terrorist attacks, the prediction model is set up, due to the impact of terrorist attacks with camouflage, there are a large number of camouflage sample and intrusive data, real samples are not enough, so the statistics can be volatile. It leads to the prediction process quite easily disturbed, and exists the problem of low accuracy. This paper puts forward the major terrorist attack risk prediction methods of data analysis, establishes a comprehensive evaluation of major terrorist attack risk data analysis model, uses big data analysis model to study the terrorist attacks of the evolution of information implied in the historical data, the results obtained are used to predict the future terrorist attacks. The simulation results show that terrorism risk prediction method based on random subspace has high precision and efficiency.

articleTitle: Analytical Calculation on Temperature Field of Concrete Cylinder by Laplace Integral Transform
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: A mathematical model of the transient heat conduction in a cylinder was developed to investigate the temperature distribution of large concrete cylinder structures subjected to the solar radiation. As the first step, meteorological parameters were used to describe the boundary conditions. Further, the Laplace transform method was adopted to develop the analytical method for the temperature field of the cylinder. Consequently, the calculation was transformed from time domain to Laplace domain. Next, the solution to Laplace domain was inversely transformed to that in time domain by stehfest inversion. In order to comply the calculation of the temperature field, a mathematical software Maple was adopted to implement the analytical method. Furthermore, the temperature field obtained with the analytical tool is verified with the measured data, which can be used to calculate the temperature field of concrete cylinder at any time in case of the solar radiation.

articleTitle: Study on Step-down DC Switching Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This system uses the TI's Buck Controller LM5117 chip and MOSFIT CSD18532KSC as the core, designing Buck DC switching power supply, whose output voltage is 5V and the output current is 3A. It discusses the design of the peripheral circuit and the parameter determination, as well as the design of PCB layout and wiring in detail. This power supply has the advantages of high speed, high precision, high efficiency, good voltage regulation and load regulation rate, no need to add auxiliary power supply board, small output ripple and so on.

articleTitle: Optimized Data-Pilot PRN Code Pairs for GPS L1C
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: To avoid the influence of pseudo-random noise (PRN) codes correlation on signal synchronization performance, we introduce a novel method to optimize the GPS Ll C signal code pairs. The distortion of the code phase discrimination curve (Le., S-Curve), caused by intra-channel PRN codes correlation properties, when only tracking the data or pilot components, is evaluated. The proposed PRN code pairs for the GPS L1C signal, based on the code set given by the L1C interface control document (ICD), are presented. The goal of the optimization process is to minimum the zero- crossing point bias of the code phase discrimination curve when the GPS L1C signal is tracked by using the pilot component for the given early-late spacing. The optimized PRN code pairs of the GPS L1C signal may obviously weakened the intra-channel interference, and can further improve the L1C signal synchronization performance.

articleTitle: Design of 3D Spatial Positioning Experiment Based on Wi-Fi
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: With the maturity of Wi-Fi technology, Wi-Fi positioning is the best choice for indoor spatial positioning. The positioning in two-dimensional space has gradually failed to meet the needs of society. On the basis of previous studies, this experiment explores the three-dimensional spatial location in Wi-Fi environment. Collecting RSS via the Wi-Fi transmission module, this paper presents an algorithm to improve RSS observations by using the average of a number of selected maximum RSS observations. Three-dimensional spatial positioning of the target is realized by using the trilateral measurement method.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis of Clamping and Self-Promotion Wheel of Car Carrier Robot
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The stereoscopic garage is an effective way to relieve the tension of urban parking space, while the car carrier robot is the key to the realization of the stereoscopic garage through lifting the wheel. Aiming at the existing wheel lifting mechanism is too complex, this paper puts forward a new type of car wheel lifting device, through the roller on the end of the device to clamp and lift the car wheels. In this paper, the dynamic analysis of the lifting mechanism is also carried out to obtain the influence rule of the design parameters on the process of car carrying, so as to better guide the mechanism parameters design.

articleTitle: The Influence of UPFC on Electrical Damping of SSO Based on Equivalent Impedance Method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The effect of unified power flow controller (UPFC) on the sub-synchronous oscillation (SSO) was analyzed in this paper. First, the dq model of UPFC which can be used to study SSO was established. Based on complex torque analysis method, the equivalent impedance of UPFC was obtained through a simplify method. With the addition of UPFC in series compensation system which would lead to SSO, the equivalent impedance of the system changes. This change makes the electrical damping improved which can effectively suppress the SSO. Furthermore the influence of the operating condition on the electrical damping is qualitatively studied. The analysis shows that the change of the line active power would affect the system damping characteristics among the main control functions of UPFC.

articleTitle: Research on Testing Instruments of High-Precision Operational Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, the current operational amplifier has many testing parameters and high precision requirements. Based on the DDS testing principle, the corresponding research work is carried out. In this paper, the input impedance, the output impedance and the maximum undistorted voltage of the amplifier can be measured. By measuring the characteristics of the parameters to be measured, different measuring methods are adopted to enlarge the testing range and improve the measurement accuracy (1 %).

articleTitle: A Cluster Head Allocation Algorithm in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: During cluster head selection in wireless sensor networks, the main concern lies in the minimization of energy consumption in the process of network information dissemination. Aiming at the problem of how to balance the energy consumption of each node in wireless sensor networks with multiple sink nodes, this paper proposes a dynamic cluster head selection algorithm and a new node energy consumption model. An energy consumption model is established by establishing the method of balancing the node energy consumption and introducing the correct transfer probability model. Through analysis, the algorithm can effectively reduce the energy consumption of the whole network and prolong the life cycle of the network. The approach can be used as a new way to replace LEACH.

articleTitle: Optical Fiber pH Sensor Based onCdSe/Zns Quantum Dot
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: We develop a new pH sensor based on quantum dots combined with optical fiber sensing and photoelectric detection platform. Compared with traditional sensors, it owns the advantage of high sensitivity, fast test, and good stability. We find there is a certain relationship between the intensity of CdSe/ZnS quantum dots and the solution pH value ranging from 2-12. This kind of fiber pH sensor would have a promising future in the field of biochemistry, environmental monitoring and food safety.

articleTitle: Comparison of EEG Changes During Action Observation, Action Observation Combined with Motor Imagery and Motor Execution of Lower Limb
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Both action observation (AO), motor imagery (MI), motor execution (ME) have been proposed as therapeutic options for stroke rehabilitation. Currently, it is not clear to what extent their underlying neuronal mechanisms differ from each other and whether one of these therapeutic options might be preferable for this purpose. This study aims to explore neuronal mechanisms between motor imagery and motor execution combine with action observation. The study compares the ERD phenomenon of EEG rhythmduring AO, action observation and motor imagery (AO+MI), action observation and motor execution (AO+ME) under the same video of the lower limb movement. AO+MI display significantly higher levels of the ERD phenomenon than AO at the center area of the brain. The ERD phenomenon of AO+MI shows greater activation than AOin the beta band (p<0.05). The ERD area of AO+ME is larger than AOin the beta band (p<0.05).A clear understanding of the ERD quantification could evaluate the change of EEG rhythm. MI, ME and AO have traditionally been viewed as separate techniques, which AO+MI, AO+ME can enhance rehabilitation.

articleTitle: An Economical Fault Current Limiter Based on Fast Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Using fault current limiter is one of the effective ways to solve the problem that short circuit current exceeds the standard in the electricity system. This paper presented an economical fault current limiter based on fast circuit breakers. After the basic principle structure, the control strategy and action logic are explained. Based on this, we analyzed the feasibility and economy in details. A new circuit structure of fault current limiter with artificial zero-crossing circuit was proposed, which will ensure that the current limited before the first peak arrives. It is more economical than superconducting, the flexible and the conventionally economical. This paper provides a reference for the development and manufacture of fault current limiters applicable to high voltage levels in engineering practice.

articleTitle: Solving Phase Ambiguity by Combining TOA with Remainder Theorem
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In the phase deblur process, this paper deeply studies the solution of the phase difference fuzzy by the remainder theorem. When the fuzzy angle range is overtravel, the remainder theorem solves a series of possible fuzzy integer solutions. In this paper, we study the idea of using TOA to do the auxiliary line, and find out the exact solution from the multi-group probable value through the Bayes decision. At the same time, the algorithm does not strictly limit the relationship between the baseline and greatly enhances the ambiguity ability.

articleTitle: Comparison and Analysis of Sound Velocity Error Correction Methods Based on Multibeam Sounding Data
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In order to reduce the sound velocity error of multibeam sounding in flat seabed, the equivalent sound velocity profile (SVP) method and the adjustment inversion method are introduced to sound velocity correction. The equivalent SVP method use the normal gradient SVP to replace the original SVP based on the relationship between sound velocity value and depth, and correct the seabed topography. The inversion method utilizes the relationship between the sound ray and the sound velocity to establish observation equation. Then, the inversion SVP are calculated from the normal equation based on the indirect adjustment theory. Finally, the distortion terrain of the seabed is corrected by the inversion SVP. The results of field experimental data are shown that: the seabed topographic values computed by the equivalent SVP and the inversion SVP are both closer to the true value of the SVP than that of the original error data. And the mean square error of depth correction has been reduced 61.3% and 72.5%, which effectively cut down the influence of the sound velocity error on seabed topography signal. And the computational efficiency of adjustment inversion method is better than the equivalent SVP method.

articleTitle: Design and Experimental Analysis of Full-Automatic Virus-Free Seedcane Seed-Metering Device
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Virus-free seedcane planting technology is one of the main technical measures for improving the unit-yield level and quality of sugarcane. To solve the defects of domestic sugarcane planting operation, including low level of mechanization, adoption of traditional semi-automatic real-time cutter type dual-bud seed stem, manual operation of seed extraction and feeding, low operation efficiency, high labor intensity, and unstable planting quality, a hydraulic seed-metering device longitudinally vibrating for arranging and horizontally provided with trough belt for seed feeding for virus-free seedcane is designed in this paper. Solid Edge ST5 is adopted to build a 3D model of the device for motion simulation, an experimental prototype is manufactured for field trial, multifactorial experiment is designed to collect data, and SPSS is adopted for statistical analysis. Analysis of the contribution of the factors to the target value impact shows that the degree of contribution of the center distance of slot is larger than that of the metering frequency, and that of the metering frequency is larger than that of the forward velocity of the engine. Optimization of regression equations shows that in the case that the forward velocity of the engine is x1 =0.4m/s, the metering frequency is x2=2 seed/s, and in the case that the length of the driving belt is x3=1.5m, the acceptability of row spacing is up to 89.6%, and the variable coefficient of row spacing is 5.0. It has been proved that the difference between the acceptability of row spacing and the result of theoretical analysis is not larger than 10%, which meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: On-Line Detection Research on Temperature of the Blast Furnace Hearth Staves and Bosh
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In view of on-line detection of temperature and problem of time response about the blast furnace hearth staves and bosh, we will show two related research in simulation experiment platform, which is based on the structure of the blast furnace hearth staves and bosh. On the one hand, we derived and demonstrated the possibility of on-line detection from the direction of heat transfer; on the other hand, we summarized experimental rule by testing the temperature distribution and time response of the experimental platform. The results demonstrate that the theoretical derivation and experimental data show a good consistency. We will be able to resolve the problem of online detection of temperature for blast furnace hearth staves and bosh, if we revise the problem according to the field situation, which provides effective data support for guiding the blast furnace can product stably and smoothly.

articleTitle: Research on the Task Allocation Based on Contract Immune Cuckoo Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Based on the background of air defense distributed element combat, the task allocation problem of multiple combat element with multiple targets under network condition is analyzed. Firstly, a mathematical model of task allocation is established by combat task decomposition. Secondly, combining the characteristic of the combat system and task allocation, an immune cuckoo algorithm based on the contract (CIC) is proposed. Finally, through the simulation calculation of typical situation, the model can be used to solve the task allocation problem.

articleTitle: Research on Parallel Hamilton-Path DNA Sequence Splicing Algorithm Based on MapReduce
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of molecular biology, the human's cognitive domain of biological has been gradually changed from pure biological traits to biological DNA sequence information analysis and structure prediction. Due to the great performance improvement of sequencers, the existing sequence splicing algorithms cannot satisfy the demand from the increasing amount of sequencing files, which has scaled up to the petabytes level. As a result, how to greatly improve the efficiency of splicing algorithms without loss of accuracy has become a hot research direction in the field of biological information. This paper adopts Hadoop parallel platform and MapReduce programming framework to make parallelization improvements to the original serial Hamilton-Path sequence splicing algorithm, aiming at solving the time efficiency problem. The experimental results on real data show that the parallel sequence splicing algorithm performs better both at the aspect of efficiency and at accuracy, and the advantage becomes more obvious along with the amount of Reads increase.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of Boiler Smoke Duct Based on CFD Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In the process of gentrification in a power plant, the direction of cold air duct is needed to change for space reasons. To control modified duct resistance value, to ensure the air duct field stability and the high temperature air preheated thermal transfer capability, CFD model which can describe its complex flow was constructed by using the Euler-Euler Double Fluid Model. Denitration reform design is completed and put into operation according to the calculation results, and then the optimal layout of the diversion plate is determined. The actual resistance value and flow field distribution and the simulation results are in good agreement after denitration reconstruction putting into operation.

articleTitle: The Enhanced Field-Emission Performance by Optimizing the Preparation Process of Carbon-Nanotube Cathode Film
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The field emission of carbon nanotube (CNT) cathode film prepared by using screen-printing method has advantageous properties. Here we try to enhance the field emission of CNT cathode films by optimizing some screen-printing processes in base of conventional method. The experiments show the CNT cathode pastes using manual grinding have great properties compared with magnetic stirring method. The test for the electrode of Ag substrates and CNTs sintered in 350°C can enormously shorten the sintering time.

articleTitle: Image Compression Based on an Improved SPIHT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Necessity of image compression is described. Wavelet transform is adopted for image compression. Extensive simulations are performed to justify the choice of the D 9/7 wavelet. SPIHT (Set Partition in Hierarchical Trees) is chosen for image coding and then improved to address its defects. Desirable PSNR (Power Signal-to-Noise Ratio) is achieved and the image is reconstructed clearly in the MATLAB simulations. Analysis of experimental data indicates that the proposed method achieves considerable improvement in PSNR.

articleTitle: Sequencing Optimization of Mixed-Model Assembly Line for Considering Time and Cost
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Aiming at the sequencing optimization problem in the mixed-model assembly line, a sequencing model is built while concerning different cost of workers in idle/overload time. Minimizing simultaneously total idle/overloaded cost as well as total product set-up time is considered as optimization objective. Moreover, a new and improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is proposed to build the model. In the algorithm, the initial population distribution is introduced into the reverse learning optimization, which can improve the search efficiency. The specific example showed that improved PSO algorithm can effectively solve the problem about mixed-model assembly lines sequencing.

articleTitle: A Robot Used for Partial Discharge Detection of Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: This paper describes a robot used for partial discharge (PD) detection of the High Voltage switch cabinet in substations. The robot, mounting a 5-DOF manipulator, carrying an integrated partial discharge detection sensor, automatically detects the partial discharge state of the switch cabinet. It is also featured with autonomous vision navigation, automatic positioning of detection points, automatic partial discharge detection and automatic recording discharge images, and it is remotely controlled by a wireless system. This paper introduces the overall technical scheme of the robot, and discusses the key technology of the robot. Now the robot is successfully applied in several substations to demonstrate its performance.

articleTitle: An Analysis Approach of Network Traffic Features for OTN Based on El Business
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Network traffic in Optical Transport Networks (OTN) holds the obviously time-varying features. These features directly affect the OTN performance. However, how to accurately characterize these properties of network traffic in OTN proposes the larger challenge. And this also has an important impact on network activities, such as network failure positioning, anomaly detection, and performance analysis. To this end, this paper propose an analysis approach to capture these properties of network traffic in OTN. Firstly, the Karhunen-Loeve transform is exploited to extract the time-varying and dynamic features of network traffic. Then according to Karhunen-Loeve transform theory, we can refine the hidden features of network traffic in the transform domain. Finally, to validate our analysis approach, we use the real network traffic data and anomalies detections to conduct a series of tests. Simulation results show that our approach is promising.

articleTitle: Optimal Frame Size of Hybrid Anti-Collision Algorithm for RFID System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The anti-collision algorithm is very important for the Radio-Frequency Identification (RFID) system. For the various possible algorithms, hybrid algorithm has the best performance because it combines the ideas of binary tree with frame-slotted ALOHA. Previous papers mainly focused on the tag population estimation and frame size. However, the time taken by different slots was not considered. In this paper, a fined-grained time model that specifies time requirements for reader and tags communications is derived. The model highlights that the duration of an idle slot is shorter than the time taken by an identification or collision slot. We use this model to deduce the optimal frame size. The optimal frame size for different RFID systems is derived numerically. The principle to select the optimal frame size is given, which is verified by simulations and a case study. Results show that we should compress the idle slot as much as possible to improve system efficiency.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of the Swinging of Payload of Ship-Mounted Crane
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The ship crane operations at sea, due to the impact of different marine environmental loads, crane will produce a certain swing, with the motion of a ship in a Seaway, according to the relevant theory of robot kinematics model established ship lifting system of crane, dynamic analysis on the influencing factors of load swing. In Matlab/Simulink, the simulation is carried out in the analysis of the characteristics of the pendulum swing with different rope lengths, different excitation frequencies and different falling speeds. The results show that the hoisting Angle increases with the increase of the rope and decreases the trend. The pendulum amplitude increases with the frequency of excitation approaching the natural frequency of the system. The lifting speed has a restraining effect on the swing of the hoisting, and the speed of decline has an enhanced effect on the swing of the hoisting.

articleTitle: Physical Layer Authentication Based on Secret Pilot
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In mobile communication system, traditional authentication mechanism is to test the sender at the higher level by using cipher algorithm to compare the result. The purpose is to prevent counterfeit behaviors of the attacker. This paper brings forward a new method of authentication on physical layer. Using the private pilot signal and hypothesis testing, the user of wireless channel is identified. In the view of signal transmission model and information theory, this paper analyzes security and puts forward the methods to generate and update private pilot. Under the typical channel model of 3GPP, simulation is carried out to verify the proposed method. Simulation results show that this method has characteristics of good performance, low computation complexity and simple practice.

articleTitle: Research on the Design and Implementation of Two Dimensional Hyper Chaotic Sequence Cipher Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In the information age of today, with the rapid development and wide application of communication technology and network technology, more and more information has been transmitted through the network and information security and protection is becoming more and more important, the cryptography theory and technology has become an important research field in Information Science and technology. In recent years, many researchers have found that there is a close relationship between chaos and cryptography. Chaotic system to initial conditions is extremely sensitive and can produce a large number of with good cryptographic properties of class randomness, correlation, complexity and wide spectrum sequence, provides a new and effective means for data encryption. But chaotic cryptography, as a new cross discipline, is still in its initial stage of development. Although many chaotic encryption schemes have been proposed, the method of chaotic cryptography is not yet fully mature. The research is carried out under such a background, to be used in chaotic map of chaotic cipher system, chaotic sequence cipher, used for key generation of chaotic random number generators and other key problems are discussed. For one-dimensional chaotic encryption algorithm key space small, security is not higher defect, this paper selects logistic mapping coupled to generate two-dimensional hyper chaotic system as the research object, the research focus on hyper chaotic sequence in the application of data encryption, in chaotic data encryption algorithm to make some beneficial attempts, at the same time, the research on applications of chaos in data encryption to do some exploring.

articleTitle: The Evaluation Method of Warship Formation Information Transmission Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Warship is the major element of seaborne fight forces, warship, whose information transmission efficiency restricts system fight efficiency. Aiming at the timeliness and veracity of warship formation information transmission, the paper constructs the evaluation index system based on mission, realizes evaluation index weight determination, and builds the polymerization model of index. At last, effective evaluation of warship formation efficiency is achieved.

articleTitle: Highly Energy-Efficient Resource Allocation in Power Telecommunication Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) has been widely used in the next generation networks. With the increasing of the wireless equipment, the problem of energy consumption for the wireless network has become a big challenge. Power control is the key of the network management, while power allocations and channel assignments have been investigated for maximizing energy efficiency in each cell in the OFDM-based cellular network. The optimal problem of maximizing energy efficiency of networks has been formulated as a non-linear fractional program. The dual decomposition and sub-gradient iteration have been used to solve it. Furthermore, a numerical simulation has been proposed to verify the algorithm proposed in this paper. The simulation results show that the maximum energy efficiency in each cell can be obtained.

articleTitle: Double Supervision Face Recognition Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Face recognition has become a hot problem in computer vision. Simultaneously, face recognition have been applied in practical life. However, many traditional feature extraction algorithms, such as Gabor, LBP, SIFT, cannot achieve a good performance. With development of deep learning, face recognition technology has achieve breakthrough, even some proposed state-of-the-art face recognition algorithms based on deep learning surpass the capable of person. In this paper, we propose double supervision face recognition to address the problem of face recognition based on deep learning. The proposed algorithm contains two supervisions: softmax supervision and triplet supervision, which is help to extract robust feature. Our proposed algorithms achieve surprise result on three public databases: LFW, AR, PubFig.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Analysis of Compound Bucket Hydraulic System of Excavator
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In order to study the hydraulic system of excavator compound bucket based on TRIZ theory, this paper designs the compound bucket hydraulic system of excavator and simulates the hydraulic cylinder work. Through the analysis of the two cylinders inside and outside the compound bucket, the design of the inner bucket hydraulic cylinder length and the piston stroke is 1/2 of the external bucket hydraulic cylinder. On this basis, the simulation of the hydraulic cylinder work is carried out to verify the feasibility of the design of the hydraulic system.

articleTitle: The Field-Emission Performance of Carbon-Nanotube Composite Graphene
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, we improved the field emission performance of carbon nanotube (CNT) material films as cathode by applying graphene to three different parameters of CNT composites. The field emission performance of CNTs has been significantly improved by applying graphene. In these three kinds of CNTs, the field emission performance of DWCNTs is the best, whose turn-on field and threshold electric field are low to 0.6 V/μm and 1.2 μm, respectively, and its current density is also high on 16 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, The second one is the type I MWCNTs, which is short and thin, and its current density is about 4-8 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The worst effect belongs to the type II MWCNTs, because its current density is generally under 2 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Power Amplifier Nonlinear Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Power amplifier (P A) is mainly composed of nonlinear components such as transistor, capacitor and inductor, with nonlinear in nature. Usually, in order to improve the work efficiency, power amplifier often works near the saturation point, where the nonlinear effect is very obvious. The channel simulator is used to simulate various channel fading characteristics, which reflects the channel characteristic truly. Power amplifier nonlinear not only causes digital signal distortion, produces intersymbol interference and causes a flip of the constellation graph, higher error rate, but also leads to signal spectrum extension, adjacent-channel interference and reduces the band utilization rate. It has serious impact on the communication system performance. Therefore, to simulate channel characteristics accurately and evaluate quality of communication system correctly, it is necessary to do research about the nonlinear simulation of the P A. Based on the channel simulator project, this paper researches the power amplifier nonlinear simulation technology and puts forward a kind of power amplifier nonlinear simulation method based on look-up table.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Affecting the Severity of Car Accidents at iNtersections Based on Cumulative Logistic Model
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: In this paper, the traffic accidents at intersections are discussed in depth, and the significant factors affecting the severity of car accidents in intersections are found out. 260 cases of the traffic accident data come from Songjiang District, Shanghai from 2008 to 2016. The severity of intersection accidents can be classified into three categories. They are death accidents, injuries accident and property damage accidents. The intersection car accident severity is selected as the dependent variable, and eleven factors from the four aspects of driver, vehicle, road and environment are selected as the candidate independent variables. The combined stepwise method is used to analyze the significant correlation between dependent variable and independent variables. The cumulative Logistic model is adopted to establish the analysis model of car accident severity at the intersection, the developed model is tested from two aspects, which are Goodness-of-fit test and parallel test.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Resource Allocation Based on Hybrid Particle Swarm Optimization in Power Telecommunication Networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: The Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) will be widely used in 5G network. However, the energy consumption has become one of main challenges in the wireless network. In this paper, we investigate the energy efficiency (EE) optimization problem in the OFDM-based cellular network. The energy efficiency performance in cellular networks is strongly affected by channel and power allocations. Then we construct an objective function to attain maximum energy efficiency with the QoS requirements of users. Then the Hybrid particle swarm optimization algorithm has been utilized to address it by obtaining the optimal channel and power allocations. We also make a numerical simulation to verify the algorithm proposed in this paper. A comparison with the Max-Min energy efficiency algorithm is also carried. The simulation results show that EE performance of our algorithm can reach convergence and is better than the Max-Min EE algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of Fixed Wing UA V with Multiple Power Sources Based on Logic Threshold
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: A complete cruise mission of the UA V with multiple power sources contains five mission stage, that is engine starting, acceleration skating, acceleration climbing, gliding and landing. For the different mission requirements of typical flight courses of the UAV, the aviation engine optimization control strategy based on logic threshold and the electromotor revolving velocity control strategy based on fuzzy compensation were utilized to optimize and control the aircraft. The necessary output power of the aviation engine and electromotor can be worked out by intelligent optimization algorithm in order to accomplish the reasonable flow among fuel, battery and capacitor under certain expected power requirements by simulation.

articleTitle: Approach to Evaluation of Satellite Information Application Chain Based on Queuing Network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of task management capability evaluation of satellite information application chain, the basic process of satellite information application chain task processing is analyzed, and the network model of satellite information task processing process is established. The model includes emergency task and general task, taking into account the priority and the deadline of task. We used the queuing network method to analyze the task processing capability of satellite application information chain, through case study, the performance of satellite information application chain is evaluated.

articleTitle: An Improved Gain Perturbation Method for Common-Mode Rejection Ratio Analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Computer Systems, Electronics and Control (ICCSEC)
abstract: Common-mode rejection ratio (CMRR) analysis in analytical form requires a careful treatment on the differential component in an operational amplifier (opamp) circuit. If not carefully modeled, inaccurate numerical result will be generated. In this work we improve an existing gain perturbation method by introducing a systematic procedure and show the improvement via an example.
